1
四川土司諸境，多有去蜀遠，去滇、黔近者。 如烏蒙、東川近於滇，烏撒、鎮雄、播州近於黔。 明太祖略定邊方，首平蜀夏，置四川布政司，使招諭諸蠻，次第歸附。 故烏蒙、烏撒、東川、芒部舊屬雲南者，皆隸於四川，不過歲輸貢賦，示以羈縻。 然夷性獷悍，嗜利好殺，爭相競尚，焚燒劫掠，習以為恒。 去省窎遠，莫能控制，附近邊民，鹹被其毒。 皆由規模草創，未嘗設立文武為之鈐轄，聽其自相雄長。 雖受天朝爵號，實自王其地。 以故終明之世，常煩撻伐。 唯建昌、松、茂等處設立衛所，播州改遵義、平越二府以後，稍安戢雲。
Many of the Sichuan native-chieftain districts lay far from the Shu heartland but close to Yunnan and Guizhou. Wumeng and Dongchuan bordered Yunnan; Wusa, Zhenxiong, and Bozhou lay nearer Guizhou. After Hongwu pacified the frontiers, he first defeated the Xia regime in Sichuan, set up the Sichuan provincial administration, and sent agents to win over the frontier peoples one by one. Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Mangbu—once part of Yunnan—were all placed under Sichuan and required only yearly tribute, a token of indirect rule. Yet the tribes were fierce by nature, greedy and bloodthirsty; they competed in raiding and burning until such violence became routine. They lay too far from the provincial seat to be controlled, and neighboring border populations suffered their depredations. This owed to the empire's still-rudimentary arrangements: no civil or military apparatus had been set up to restrain them, and they were left to fight among themselves for dominance. Though they bore imperial titles, in practice they ruled their own domains like kings. Hence punitive expeditions were needed again and again throughout the Ming. Only after guard posts were set up at Jianchang, Song, Mao, and elsewhere, and Bozhou was reorganized into the prefectures of Zunyi and Pingyue, did the region grow somewhat quieter.

○四川土司一
○ Sichuan Tribal Headmen, Part 1
3
烏蒙烏撒東川鎮雄四軍民府馬湖建昌衛 〈 （寧番衛越巂衛鹽井衛會川衛）〉 茂州衛松潘衛天全六番招討司黎州安撫司
Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, Zhenxiong—the four military-civilian prefectures; Mahu; Jianchang Guard ( (Ningfan Guard, Yuexi Guard, Yanjing Guard, Huichuan Guard) Maozhou Guard, Songpan Guard, the Tianquan Six-Banner Pacification Commission, and the Lizhou Pacification Commission
4
烏蒙烏撒東川鎮雄四軍民府
The four military-civilian prefectures: Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Zhenxiong
5
烏蒙、烏撒、東川、芒部，古為竇地、的巴、東川、大雄諸甸，皆唐烏蒙裔也。 宋有封烏蒙王者。 元初置烏蒙路，遂以東川、芒部皆隸於烏蒙、烏撒等處宣慰司。 烏撒富盛甲諸部，元時嘗置軍民總管府，而於東川置萬戶府。 地勢並在蜀之東南，與滇、黔壤土相接，皆據險阻深，與中土聲教隔離。
Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Mangbu were anciently the districts of Dou, Diba, Dongchuan, and Daxiong—all offshoots of the Tang-era Wumeng line. Under the Song, rulers of Wumeng received royal enfeoffment. Early in the Yuan, Wumeng Circuit was created, and Dongchuan and Mangbu were placed under the Wumeng–Wusa Pacification Commission. Wusa was the richest of the districts; under the Yuan a military-civilian chief's office was established there and a wanhu office at Dongchuan. All lay southeast of Shu, bordering Yunnan and Guizhou in rugged country far removed from central Chinese civilization.
6
明太祖既平蜀，規取雲南，大師皆集於辰、沅，欲並剪諸蠻以通蜀道。 洪武十四年遣內臣賫敕諭烏蒙、烏撒諸部長曰：「西南諸部，自古及今，莫不朝貢中國。 朕受天命為天下主十有五年，而烏蒙、烏撒、東川、芒部、建昌諸部長猶桀驁不朝。 朕已遣征南將軍潁川侯、左副將軍永昌侯、右副將軍西平侯率師往征。 猶恐諸部長未喻朕意，故復遣內臣往諭。 如悔罪向義，當即躬親來朝，或遣人入貢，亟攄誠款，朕當罷兵，以安黎庶。 爾共省之。 」時征南將軍傅友德已分遣都督胡海洋等帥師五萬，由永寧趨烏撒，復自率師由曲靖循格孤山而南，以通永寧之兵，搗烏撒。 時元右丞實卜聞海洋兵至，乃聚兵赤水河以拒之。 及聞大軍繼進，皆遁。 友德令諸軍築城，版閘方具，蠻寇大集。 友德屯兵山岡，持重以待。 既知士勇可用，乃縱兵接戰。 有芒部土酋率眾來援，實卜兵與合，鋒甚銳。 大軍鼓噪而前，其酋長多中槊墜馬死。 大軍益奮，蠻眾力不支，大潰，斬首三千，獲馬六百，實卜率眾遁。 遂城烏撒，克七星關以通畢節，又克可渡河，於是東川、烏蒙、芒部諸蠻震詟，皆望風降附。
Once Hongwu had pacified Sichuan, he turned toward Yunnan; the main armies massed at Chen and Yuan, intending to subdue the tribes and open the route into Shu. In Hongwu 14 an imperial messenger was sent with an edict to the chiefs of Wumeng, Wusa, and the rest: 'From antiquity the southwestern peoples have all paid tribute to China. I have ruled by Heaven's mandate for fifteen years, yet the chiefs of Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, Mangbu, Jianchang, and elsewhere remain defiant and have not presented themselves at court. I have already sent the Pacification-General of the South, the Marquis of Yingchuan, with the Marquises of Yongchang and Xiping as his deputies, to march against you. Fearing you may not yet understand my intent, I send this messenger again to make it plain. If you repent and submit, come to court yourself or send tribute at once and declare your loyalty; I will then halt the army and spare the people. Consider this carefully, all of you.' ' By then Fu Youde had already sent Commissioner-in-chief Hu Haiyang with fifty thousand men from Yongning toward Wusa, while he himself marched south from Qujing along Gegu Mountain to join the Yongning column and strike Wusa. When the Yuan Right Chancellor Sapu heard that Haiyang's force was approaching, she massed troops at the Chishui River to block them. When they learned that the main army was close behind, they all fled. Youde ordered his men to build a fort; scarcely had the gates been set when barbarian forces massed in great numbers. Youde held his men on a hill and waited cautiously. Once he was satisfied that his troops were ready, he sent them into battle. A Mangbu chief came with reinforcements; combined with Sapu's force, their charge was fierce. The imperial army advanced with drums and shouts; many chiefs were speared from their horses and killed. The army pressed harder; the tribes could not stand and broke; three thousand heads were taken and six hundred horses captured, while Sapu fled with her followers. They fortified Wusa, seized Qixing Pass to open the route to Bijie, and took the Kedu River crossing; Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Mangbu were terrified and submitted as the army approached.
7
十五年置東川、烏撒、烏蒙、芒部諸衛指揮使司，詔諭諸部人民。 以雲南已降附，宜益效順中國，以享升平。 復諭諸部長曰：「今置郵傳通雲南，宣率土人，隨其疆界遠邇，開築道路，各廣十丈，準古法，以六十里為一驛。 符至奉行。 」又敕征南將軍友德等曰：「烏蒙、烏撒、東川、芒部諸酋長雖已降，恐大軍一還，仍復嘯聚。 符到日，悉送其酋長入朝。 」又諭以貴州已設都指揮使，然地勢偏東，今宜於實卜所居之地立司，以便控制，卿其審之。 」已，烏撒諸蠻復叛，帝諭友德曰：「烏撒諸蠻伺官軍散處，即有此變，朕前已慮之，今果然。 然雲南之地如曲靖、普安、烏撒、建昌，勢在必守，其東川、芒部、烏蒙，未可遽守也。 且留屯大軍蕩埽諸蠻，戮其渠長，方可分兵守禦耳。 」乃命安陸侯吳復為總兵，平涼侯費聚副之，征烏撒、烏蒙諸叛蠻。 並諭勿與蠻戰於關索嶺上，當分兵掩襲，直搗其巢，使彼各奔救其家之不暇，必不敢出以抗大師。 俟三將軍至，破擒之。 是月，副將軍西平侯沐英自大理還軍，會友德擊烏撒，大敗其眾，斬首三萬余級，獲馬牛羊萬計，余眾悉遁，復追擊破之。 帝諭友德等，師捷後，必戮其渠魁，使之畏懼。 搜其余黨，絕其根株，使彼智窮力屈，誠心款附，方可留兵鎮守。 又諭宜乘兵勢修治道途，令土酋諭其民，各輸糧一石以給軍，為持久計。
In the fifteenth year guard commands were set up for Dongchuan, Wusa, Wumeng, Mangbu, and the rest, and the peoples of those districts were instructed by edict. Because Yunnan had already submitted, they were urged to show still greater loyalty to the empire and enjoy the blessings of peace. The chiefs were told again: 'Postal routes to Yunnan are now in place. Lead your people to open roads ten zhang wide along your borders, one post station every sixty li as in ancient usage. When the order arrives, obey it without delay.' Youde and the other commanders were also instructed: "Though the chiefs of Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Mangbu have submitted, they may rally again once the army withdraws." When this order reaches you, send all their chiefs to court.' ' Guizhou already has a regional military commission, but it lies too far east; establish a new office where Sapu resides to tighten control—consider this carefully.' "Before long the Wusa tribes rebelled again." The emperor told Youde: "They rose because our troops were scattered in garrisons—I foresaw this, and so it has proved. Qujing, Pu'an, Wusa, and Jianchang in Yunnan must be held, but Dongchuan, Mangbu, and Wumeng cannot yet be garrisoned. Keep the main force there to crush the tribes and execute their leaders; only then may you divide troops for garrison duty.' Wu Fu, Marquis of Anlu, was appointed commander-in-chief, with Fei Ju, Marquis of Pingliang, as his deputy, to campaign against the rebellious tribes of Wusa and Wumeng. They were told not to fight on Guansuo Ridge but to divide their forces, strike the enemy strongholds directly, and force them to rush home to defend their families rather than face the main army. When the three generals arrive, defeat and capture them. That month Mu Ying, Marquis of Xiping, marched back from Dali, joined Youde against Wusa, and routed the enemy—more than thirty thousand heads were taken and countless livestock seized; the survivors fled and were pursued and broken again. The emperor told Youde and the others that after victory they must execute the ringleaders to instill fear. Hunt down the remaining followers, uproot them completely, and only when the tribes are exhausted and submit in good faith may garrisons be left behind. They were also told: "Repair the roads while military momentum holds; have the chiefs require each household to deliver one shi of grain for the army, and plan for a long campaign."
8
十六年以雲南所屬烏撒、烏蒙、芒部三府隸四川布政使司。 烏蒙、烏撒、東川、芒部諸部長百二十人來朝，貢方物。 詔各授以官，賜朝服、冠帶、錦騎、鈔錠有差。 其烏撒女酋實卜，加賜珠翠。 芒部知府發紹、烏蒙知府阿普病卒，詔賜綺衣並棺殮之具，遣官致祭，歸其柩於家。 十七年割雲南東川府隸四川布政府司，並烏撒、烏蒙、芒部皆改為軍民府，而定其賦稅。 烏撒歲輸二萬石，氈衫一千五百領； 烏蒙、東川、芒部皆歲輸八千石，氈衫八百領。 又定茶鹽布疋易馬之數，烏撒歲易馬六千五百匹，烏蒙、東川、芒部皆四千匹。 凡馬一匹，給布三十疋，或茶一百斤，鹽如之。 實卜復貢馬，賜綺鈔。 十八年，烏蒙知府亦德言，蠻地刀耕火種，比年霜旱疾疫，民饑窘，歲輸之糧無從徵納。 詔悉免之。 二十年徵烏撒知府阿能赴京。
In the sixteenth year Wusa, Wumeng, and Mangbu—the three prefectures formerly under Yunnan—were placed under the Sichuan provincial administration. One hundred and twenty chiefs from Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, Mangbu, and elsewhere came to court with tribute. Each was appointed to office and granted court dress, caps and belts, brocade horses, and paper money in varying amounts. Sapu, the female chief of Wusa, received an additional gift of pearls and kingfisher ornaments. Fa Shao, prefect of Mangbu, and Apu, prefect of Wumeng, died; the court granted brocade burial garments and coffin fittings, sent officials to perform the rites, and returned their remains to their families. In the seventeenth year Dongchuan was transferred from Yunnan to Sichuan; Wusa, Wumeng, and Mangbu were all redesignated military-civilian prefectures and their tax obligations fixed. Wusa was to deliver twenty thousand shi of grain and fifteen hundred felt garments yearly; Wumeng, Dongchuan, and Mangbu were each to deliver eight thousand shi and eight hundred felt garments yearly. Quotas for horse trade in tea, salt, and cloth were also set: Wusa six thousand five hundred horses a year; Wumeng, Dongchuan, and Mangbu four thousand each. For each horse the price was thirty bolts of cloth, or one hundred jin of tea, or an equivalent amount of salt. Sapu presented horses again and received brocade and paper money in return. In the eighteenth year Yide, prefect of Wumeng, reported that slash-and-burn farming, combined with frost, drought, and plague, had left the people destitute and unable to pay the annual grain levy. An edict remitted the entire levy. In the twentieth year Aneng, prefect of Wusa, was summoned to the capital.
9
二十一年命西平侯沐英南征。 英言，東川強盛，據烏山路作亂，罪狀已著，必先加兵。 但其地重關復嶺，上下三百餘里，人跡阻絕，須以大兵臨之。 帝命潁國公傅友德仍為征南將軍，英與陳桓為左桓副將軍，率諸軍進討。 敕友德等曰：「東川、芒部諸夷，種類皆出於羅羅。 厥後子姓蕃衍，各立疆場，乃異其名曰東川、烏撒、烏蒙、芒部、祿肇、水西。 無事則互起爭端，有事則相為救援。 若唐時閣羅鳳亡居大理，唐兵追捕，道經芒部諸境，君蠻聚眾據險設伏。 唐將不備，遂墮其計，喪師二十萬，皆將帥無謀故也。 今須預加防閑，嚴為之備。 」烏撒軍民府葉原常獻馬三百匹、米四百石於征南將軍，以資軍用，且願收集土兵從征。 英等以聞，從之。 復命景川侯曹震、靖寧侯葉升等分討東川，平之，捕獲叛蠻五千五百三十八人。
In the twenty-first year Mu Ying, Marquis of Xiping, was ordered south on campaign. Ying reported that Dongchuan was strong, had seized the Wushan road and rebelled, and must be attacked first. But the region was a maze of passes and ridges more than three hundred li deep, all but impassable—a large force would be needed. The emperor appointed Fu Youde, Duke of Ying, Pacification-General of the South again, with Mu Ying and Chen Huan as his deputies, to lead the campaign. Youde and the others were instructed: 'The peoples of Dongchuan, Mangbu, and the rest all descend from the Lolo. Their descendants later spread out, each carving a domain, and took different names: Dongchuan, Wusa, Wumeng, Mangbu, Luzhao, and Shuixi. In peace they quarreled among themselves; in war they aided one another. In Tang times, when Nanzhao's Piluoge fled to Dali and Tang troops pursued him through Mangbu, the chiefs massed their followers, held the passes, and laid ambushes. The Tang generals were caught unprepared, fell into the trap, and lost two hundred thousand men—all for want of foresight in their commanders. Take precautions now and prepare thoroughly.' Ye Yuanchang of Wusa presented three hundred horses and four hundred shi of rice to the southern command and offered to raise native troops for the campaign. Ying reported this and the request was approved. Cao Zhen, Marquis of Jingchuan, Ye Sheng, Marquis of Jingning, and others were sent against Dongchuan separately; they pacified it and took five thousand five hundred thirty-eight rebels prisoner.
10
二十三年，烏撒土知府阿能，烏蒙、芒部土官，各遣子弟入監讀書。 二十七年，烏撒知府卜穆奏，沾益州屢侵其地，命沐春諭之。 二十八年，戶部言：「烏撒、烏蒙、芒部、東川歲賦氈衫不如數，詔已免徵。 今有司仍追之，宜申明。 」從之。 二十九年，烏蒙軍民府知府實哲貢馬及氈衫。 自是，諸土知府三年一入貢，以為常，或有恩賜，則進馬及方物謝恩。
In the twenty-third year Aneng of Wusa and the native officials of Wumeng and Mangbu each sent sons and younger brothers to the imperial school. In the twenty-seventh year Bumu, prefect of Wusa, reported repeated encroachments by Zhanyi; Mu Chun was ordered to settle the dispute. In the twenty-eighth year the Ministry of Revenue reported: 'The annual felt-garment levies of Wusa, Wumeng, Mangbu, and Dongchuan have fallen short, though collection was already remitted by edict. Local officials are still pressing for payment; this should be clarified.' The request was granted. In the twenty-ninth year Shizhe, prefect of Wumeng, presented horses and felt garments as tribute. Thereafter the native prefects presented tribute every three years as a rule; when the court granted favors they would offer horses and local products in gratitude.
11
宣德七年，兵部侍郎王驥言，烏蒙、烏撒土官祿昭、尼祿等，爭地仇殺，宜遣官按問。 八年遣行人章聰、侯璉賫敕往諭，仍敕巡按與三司官往平之。 設烏蒙儒學教授、訓導各一員。 以通判黃甫越言，元時本府向有學校，今文廟雖存，師儒未建。 乞除教官，選俊秀子弟入學讀書，以廣文治，從之。
In Xuande 7 Wang Ji, Vice Minister of War, reported that Lu Zhao of Wumeng, Ni Lu of Wusa, and others were feuding over land and killing one another; officials should be sent to investigate. In the eighth year Zhang Cong and Hou Lian were sent with an edict, and the touring censor and the three commissions were ordered to settle the dispute. A Confucian professor and an instructor were appointed for Wumeng. Sub-prefect Huangfu Yue reported that Wumeng had had a school under the Yuan and that the temple still stood, but no teachers had been appointed. He asked that instructors be appointed and talented youths enrolled to extend civil governance; the request was granted.
12
成化十二年，烏撒知府隴舊等奏，同知剛正撫字有方，蠻民信服，今九年秩滿，乞再任三年，以慰群望。 從之。 弘治十四年，烏撒所轄可渡河巡檢司言：「自閏七月二十七日，大雷雨不止，至二十九日，水漲山崩地裂，山鳴如牛吼，地陷湧出清泉數十派，沖壞廬舍橋梁及壓死人口牲畜無算。 又本府阿都地方，八月亦暴風雨，田土渰沒二百余處，死者三百余人。」
In Chenghua 12 Long Jiu of Wusa and others reported that Vice-prefect Gangzheng had governed effectively and won the tribes' trust; his nine-year term was ending, and they asked that he serve three more years. The request was granted. In Hongzhi 14 the Kedu River inspection office under Wusa reported: 'From the twenty-seventh of the intercalary seventh month thunder and rain did not cease until the twenty-ninth; floods rose, mountains collapsed, the earth split, hills roared like cattle, springs burst from the ground, and countless homes, bridges, people, and livestock were destroyed. In Adou district of this prefecture violent storms in the eighth month inundated more than two hundred fields and killed more than three hundred people.'
13
正德十五年討斬芒部僰蠻阿又磉等。 初，芒部土舍隴壽，與庶弟隴政及兄妻支祿爭襲仇殺。 所部僰蠻阿又磉等乘機倡亂流劫。 事聞，命鎮守中官會撫按官捕治。 至是，貴州參政傅習、都指揮許詔，督永寧宣撫司女土官奢爵等，討擒阿又磉等四十三人，斬一百十九級，事乃定。
In Zhengde 15 Ayouseng and other Bo tribesmen of Mangbu were attacked and executed. Earlier Long Shou, a Mangbu tribal clerk, had feuded with his half-brother Long Zheng and his sister-in-law Zhilu over the succession, each faction killing the other. Bo tribesmen under his command, including Ayouseng, seized the moment to rebel and rampage through the countryside. On report of the disturbance, the court ordered the garrison eunuch to work with the provincial overseers to arrest the culprits. Fu Xi, Guizhou vice commissioner, and Xu Zhao, regional commander, led She Jue of Yongning and other native officials against Ayouseng's band, capturing forty-three rebels and taking 119 heads before order was restored.
14
嘉靖元年命芒部護印土舍隴壽襲知府，免赴京。 故事，土官九品以上，皆保送至京乃襲。 時壽、政等爭襲，不敢離任。 朝廷以嫡故立壽，恐壽赴京而政等乘隙為亂，故有是命。 然政與支祿倚烏撒土舍安寧等兵力，仇殺如故。 壩底參將何卿請於巡撫許廷光，發土兵二萬五千人，命貴州參將楊仁等將之，受何卿節制，相機進剿政、祿佯聽撫，乞緩師，而令賊黨阿黑等掠周泥站、七星關，復遣阿核等糾集諸苗，剽掠畢節諸處，殺傷官軍，毀官民房屋甚眾。 兵部言賊勢猖獗，宜速征。 於是可卿等進剿，斬首二百余級，俘二十余人，降其眾數百，政敗奔烏撒，卿檄烏撒土舍安寧、土婦奢勿擒之。 安寧佯許諾，僅以阿核等屍獻，竟不出政，兵久不解。 都御史湯沐以聞，詔切責諸將及守巡官罪，而革何卿冠帶，令剿賊自贖。
In Jiajing 1 the court confirmed Long Shou, Mangbu's seal-keeper, as prefect and exempted him from traveling to Beijing. By precedent, native officials ranked ninth grade or higher had to be escorted to Beijing before taking office. Shou, Zheng, and their factions were still fighting over the succession and would not leave their posts. The court had named Shou heir as the legitimate branch and feared that his absence in Beijing would let Zheng's faction stir up trouble—hence the exemption. Zheng and Zhilu still drew on Wusa's An Ning and his forces, and the blood feud continued unabated. He Qing, vice commander at Badi, asked Grand Coordinator Xu Tingguang for twenty-five thousand tribal troops under Yang Ren and other Guizhou commanders, all under He's direction. While Zheng and Zhilu pretended to submit and pleaded for a halt to operations, their agents Ahei and others raided Zhouni Station and Qixing Pass; Ahe rallied Miao bands to loot Bijie, killing soldiers and civilians and destroying countless homes. The Ministry of War urged a prompt campaign—the rebels were too strong to wait. He Qing pressed the attack, taking 200 heads, twenty prisoners, and several hundred surrenderers; Zheng fled to Wusa, and He ordered An Ning and the native woman She Wu to capture him. An Ning feigned agreement, offering only the bodies of Ahe and his companions, and never surrendered Zheng; the campaign dragged on. Censor-in-chief Tang Mu reported the situation; the emperor rebuked the generals and local officials, stripped He Qing of rank, and ordered him to crush the rebels or forfeit his post.
15
四年，政誘殺壽，奪其印。 巡撫王軏、巡按劉黻各上其事。 黻言從蠻情，立支祿便。 軏以隴政、支祿怙終稔惡，戕朝廷命吏，罪不可赦。 乃命鎮巡官諭安寧，縛政、祿及諸助惡者。 時政已為官軍擒於水西，追獲芒部印信，前後斬首六百七十四級，生擒一百六十七人，招撫白烏石等四十九寨，以捷聞。 貴州巡按劉廷簠言：「烏撒所獻阿核等屍，及水西所縛隴政，真偽未可信，恐首惡尚在，不無後慮，請核實。 」五年，兵部奏：「芒部隴氏，釁起蕭墻，騷動兩省，王師大舉，始克蕩平。 今其本屬親支已盡，無人承襲，請改為鎮雄府，設流官知府統之。 分屬夷良、毋響、落角利之地，為懷德、歸化、威信、安靜四長官司，使隴氏疏屬阿濟、白壽、祖保、阿萬四人統之。 如程番府例，令三年一入朝，貢馬十二匹，而以通判程洸為試知府。」
In the fourth year Zheng murdered Shou by treachery and seized the prefectural seal. Grand Coordinator Wang E and Regional Inspector Liu Fei each reported the killing to the throne. Liu Fei argued that appointing Zhilu would align with tribal sentiment. Wang E countered that Zheng and Zhilu had long defied the court, murdered imperial appointees, and deserved no mercy. The court ordered frontier officials to tell An Ning to arrest Zheng, Zhilu, and their accomplices. Zheng was already in government hands in Shuixi; the Mangbu seal was recovered; in all 674 heads were taken, 167 prisoners captured, and forty-nine stockades including Baiwushi pacified before the victory report went up. Guizhou inspector Liu Tingfan wrote: "The bodies from Wusa and the captive Long Zheng from Shuixi may be fraudulent; unless the ringleaders are truly dead, trouble may return—please verify. In the fifth year the Ministry of War reported: "The Long clan of Mangbu turned kin against kin and roiled two provinces; only a major expedition finally subdued them. With no legitimate heir left, the ministry proposed converting the territory to Zhenxiong Prefecture under a Han appointee. The territory would be split into four senior native offices—Huaide, Guihua, Weixin, and Anjing—under distant Long kinsmen Aji, Bai Shou, Zubao, and Awan. Following the Chenfan model, they would present tribute every three years with twelve horses; Vice Prefect Cheng Guang would serve as acting prefect."
16
六年，芒部賊沙保等謀復隴氏，擁隴壽子勝糾眾攻陷鎮雄城，執程洸，奪其印，殺傷數百人，洸奔畢節。 事聞，兵科給事中鄭自壁等言：「鎮雄初設流官，蠻情未服，而有司失先事之防，不亟收遣裔隴勝，而令沙保得擁孺子，致煽禍一方。 宜速遣總兵何卿並力剿寇。 」於是兵部覆言：「隴勝非真隴壽子，故議設流官，有司撫循失策，遂生叛亂。 沙保罪不容誅，當剿。 何卿方守松潘，勢難相援，宜亟趣都御史王廷相之任，並敕總兵牛桓調兵速進。 」時沙保出鎮雄府印乞降，然尚持兩端，欲立土官如故。 四川撫按以保狡悍不可馴，檄瀘州守備丁勇擊之。 又遣使勞賜芒部撫夷郤良佐，使計擒沙保。 保怒，復叛。
In the sixth year Shabao and other Mangbu rebels backed Long Shou's purported son Sheng, stormed Zhenxiong, seized Acting Prefect Cheng Guang and his seal, killed hundreds, and drove Guang to Bijie. Supervising secretary Zheng Zibi and others protested: "With Zhenxiong's new Han prefect, the tribes were still restless; officials failed to detain Long Sheng early, letting Shabao raise a puppet heir and ignite rebellion. They urged an immediate joint campaign under Regional Commander He Qing. The Ministry of War replied: "Sheng was not Shou's true son—hence the shift to Han rule; bungled pacification had sparked revolt. Shabao deserved no mercy and must be crushed. He Qing was tied down at Songpan; Wang Tingxiang should take command at once and Niu Huan hurry reinforcements forward." Shabao offered the Zhenxiong seal in surrender but hedged, still seeking restoration of native rule. Sichuan's overseers deemed Shabao incorrigible and ordered Luzhou defender Ding Yong to strike. They also rewarded Mangbu pacifier Xi Liangzuo to entrap Shabao. Enraged, Shabao rose again.
17
七年，川、貴諸軍會剿，敗沙保等，擒斬三百余級，招撫蠻羅男婦以千計。 捷聞，設鎮雄流官如舊。 而芒部、烏撒、毋響苗蠻隴革等復起，攻劫畢節屯堡，殺掠士民，紛紛見告。 兵部尚書李承勛以伍文定專主用兵為失計，疏及之。 而御史楊彜復言芒部改土易流非長策，又時值荒饉，小民救死不贍，何能趣戰。 時帝亦軫念災傷，令罷芒部兵，俟有秋再議征討。 於是四川巡撫唐鳳儀言：「烏蒙、烏撒、東川諸土官，故與芒部為唇齒。 自芒部改流，諸部內懷不安，以是反者數起。 今懷德長官阿濟等雖自詭擒賊，其心固望隴勝得一職，以存隴後。 臣請如宣德中復安南故事，俯順輿情，則不假兵而禍源自塞。 」川、貴巡按戴金、陳講等奏如鳳儀言。 金又以首惡如毋響、祖保等，宜剿誅以折其驕氣，始下撫處之令，許生獻沙保等，待阿濟以不死，然後復隴勝故職，或降為知州。 其長官或因或革，或分隸，庶操縱得宜，恩威並著。 章下部覆，乃革鎮雄流官知府，而以隴勝為通判，署鎮雄府事。 令三年後果能率職奉貢，準復知府舊銜。 時嘉靖九年四月也。
In the seventh year Sichuan and Guizhou forces routed Shabao, taking 300 heads and accepting the surrender of a thousand Luo tribespeople. Victory reports restored the Han prefect at Zhenxiong. Yet Long Ge and other Mangbu, Wusa, and Buxiang tribesmen raided Bijie forts, slaughtering civilians; petitions flooded in. War Minister Li Chengxun criticized Wu Wendding's military-only approach in a memorial. Censor Yang Yi argued that replacing Mangbu's native rule with Han officials was unsound, especially amid famine when peasants could barely survive, let alone fight. The emperor, moved by the suffering, suspended the Mangbu campaign until after the harvest. Grand Coordinator Tang Fengyi wrote: "Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and neighboring native officials had long been Mangbu's allies. After Mangbu's conversion to Han administration, they grew uneasy and rebellions multiplied. Though Huaide officer Aji claimed to hunt rebels, he still hoped to restore Long Sheng and preserve the clan. He urged a Xuande-style concession to local sentiment so peace might return without further bloodshed. Sichuan and Guizhou inspectors Dai Jin and Chen Jiang endorsed Fengyi's proposal. Dai Jin added that ringleaders like Buxiang and Zubao must be killed to break their pride before offering amnesty; live capture of Shabao should be rewarded, Aji spared, and Long Sheng restored—or demoted to prefect. Senior offices could be retained, abolished, or reassigned so the court could balance mercy and force. The ministry approved: Zhenxiong's Han prefect was removed and Long Sheng made vice prefect in charge of the prefecture. If within three years he governed dutifully and paid tribute, he might regain the full prefectural title. This was in the fourth month of Jiajing 9.
18
三十九年命勘東川阿堂之亂。 初，東川土知府祿慶死，子位幼，妻安氏攝府事。 有營長阿得革頗擅權，謀奪其官。 因先求烝安氏不得，乃縱火焚府治，走武定州，為土官所殺。 得革子堂奔水西，賄結烏撒土官安泰，入東川，囚安氏，奪其印。 貴州宣慰安萬銓故與祿氏姻連，乃起兵攻阿堂所居寨，破之。 堂妻阿聚攜幼子奔沾益州土官安九鼎。 萬銓脅九鼎，取阿聚及幼子殺之。 堂以是怨九鼎，時相攻擊。 堂兵侵羅雄州境，九鼎及祿位與羅雄土官者浚等，各上書訟堂罪。 詔下雲、貴、四川撫按官會勘。 堂聽勘於車洪江，具服罪，願獻所劫府印並沾益、羅雄人口牲畜及侵地，乞貸死。 時位及弟僎已前歿，官府因訊祿氏所當襲者，堂以己幼子詭名祿哲以報。 據府印如故，復與九鼎治兵相攻。 九鼎訴之雲南巡撫遊居敬，謂堂怙亂，請致討，且自詭當率所部為前鋒，必擒堂以獻。 居敬信之，遂上疏言堂念惡不悛，請專意進剿，為地方除害。 帝允部議，行川、貴撫按會勘具奏。 居敬遽調土漢兵五萬余進剿。 雲南承平久，一旦兵動，費用不貲，賦斂百出，諸軍衛及有司土官舍等乘之為奸利，遠近騷動。 巡按王大任言：「逆堂奪印謀官，法所必誅。 第彼猶借朝廷之印以約土蠻，冒祿氏之宗以圖世職，而四川之差稅辦納以時，雲、貴之鄰壤未見侵越，此其非叛明矣。 其與九鼎治兵相攻，彼此俱屬有罪。 居敬乃信一偏之詭辭，違會勘之明旨，輕動大眾，恐生意外患。 且外議籍籍，謂居敬入九鼎重賄，欲為雪怨，及受各土官賂，攘盜帑積，皆有實跡。 請亟罷居敬，暫停征剿為便。 」乃命逮居敬。 時堂聞大兵至東川，逃深箐，諸將分兵於新舊諸城，窮搜不獲，地方民夷大遭屠掠。
In the thirty-ninth year the court ordered an inquiry into A Tang's rebellion in Dongchuan. Dongchuan prefect Lu Qing had died, leaving a young heir Wei; his widow Lady An ruled as regent. Camp chief Adege had grown powerful and plotted to seize the prefecture. Denied levirate marriage with Lady An, he burned the yamen, fled to Wuding, and was killed by its native official. Adege's son Tang fled to Shuixi, bribed Wusa's An Tai, invaded Dongchuan, imprisoned Lady An, and seized the seal. An Wanzuan of Guizhou, allied to the Lu by marriage, attacked Tang's stronghold and destroyed it. Tang's wife Aju fled with their infant son to Zhanyi's An Jiuding. Wanzuan forced Jiuding to surrender Aju and the child, then had them killed. Tang hence hated Jiuding, and the two traded attacks. Tang raided Luoxiong; Jiuding, Lu Wei, and Luoxiong's Zhe Jun petitioned the throne against him. The court ordered Yunnan, Guizhou, and Sichuan overseers to investigate jointly. At Chehong River Tang submitted to inquiry, confessed, offered the stolen seal and seized people, livestock, and lands of Zhanyi and Luoxiong, and begged for his life. Wei and his brother Zhuan were already dead; when officials asked who should inherit, Tang named his infant son falsely as Lu Zhe. He kept the seal and again fought Jiuding. Jiuding appealed to Grand Coordinator You Jujing, calling Tang incorrigible and offering to lead his tribes as vanguard and deliver Tang captive. You Jujing believed him and memorialized that Tang remained unreformed and should be exterminated for the region's safety. The emperor approved and ordered Sichuan and Guizhou overseers to investigate and report. Jujing hastily raised over fifty thousand tribal and regular troops. Long peace in Yunnan shattered: costs soared, levies multiplied, garrisons and native officials profiteered, and the region convulsed. Inspector Wang Daren wrote: "Tang usurped the seal and sought office—legally he must die. Yet he still ruled by the court's seal, posed as Lu heir, paid Sichuan taxes on time, and had not invaded Yunnan or Guizhou—hardly full rebellion. His war with Jiuding was a feud in which both were culpable. Jujing trusted one party's lies, defied the joint-inquiry mandate, and risked disaster by mobilizing a huge army. Rumors held that Jujing took Jiuding's bribes to settle a vendetta and native officials' bribes to loot the treasury—charges with substance. He urged Jujing's immediate recall and a halt to the campaign." The court ordered Jujing arrested. Tang fled into the mountains as troops overran Dongchuan; generals ravaged old and new towns without catching him, and civilians suffered massacre.
19
四十年，營長者阿易謀於堂之心腹母勒阿濟等，掩殺堂於戛來矣石之地，其子阿哲就擒，哲時年八歲。 事雖定，而府印不知所在。 於是安萬銓取東川府經歷印，畀祿位妻寧著署之，以照磨印畀羅雄土官者浚，而以寧著女妻者浚子。 仍留水西兵三千於東川，為寧著防衛。 水西與東川鄰，萬銓本水西土官，故議者謂其有陰據東川之誌。 巡按王大任以誅阿堂聞，因言：「東川地方殘傷，該府三印悉為土官部置，請通敕川、貴總督及鎮巡官，按究各土官私擅標署之罪。 並訪祿氏支派之宜立，與所以處阿哲者。 」部覆報可。
In the fortieth year camp chief Zhe Ayi and Tang's confidantes, including Le Aji, ambushed and killed Tang at Galai Yishi; his son Azhe, eight years old, was seized. The crisis ended, but the prefectural seal was missing. An Wanzuan gave Lu Wei's widow Ning Zhu the prefecture's administration seal, gave Luoxiong's Zhe Jun the registrar seal, and married Ning Zhu's daughter to Zhe Jun's son. He left three thousand Shuixi troops in Dongchuan to guard Ning Zhu. Because Wanzuan was a Shuixi native official on Dongchuan's border, critics said he meant to annex the prefecture. Inspector Wang Daren, reporting Tang's death, wrote: "Dongchuan lies in ruins; all three prefectural seals are held by native officials; he asked Sichuan and Guizhou commanders to punish unauthorized seal-holding, and who should inherit the Lu line and what to do with the captive Azhe." The ministry approved.
20
四十一年鑄給四川東川府印。 初，阿堂既誅，索府印不獲，人疑為安萬銓所匿，及是屢勘，印實亡失。 而祿位近派悉絕，惟同六世祖有幼男阿采。 撫按官雷賀、陳瓚請以采襲祿氏職，姑予同知銜，令寧著署掌，後果能撫輯其眾，仍進襲知府。 其新印請更名，以防奸偽。 有旨不必更，余如議。 先是，烏撒與永寧、烏蒙、沾益、水西諸土官，境土相連，世戚親厚，既而以各私所親，彼此構禍，奏訐紛紜，詳四川《永寧土司傳》中，當事者頗厭苦之。 萬歷六年乃令照蠻俗罰牛例處分，務悔禍息爭，以保境安民，然終不能靖也。
In the forty-first year the court cast a new seal for Sichuan's Dongchuan Prefecture. After Tang's execution the seal could not be found; many suspected Wanzuan had hidden it, but repeated inquiries proved it lost. Lu Wei's immediate line was extinct; only a young kinsman A Cai of the sixth generation remained. Overseers Lei He and Chen Zan proposed A Cai as heir with subprefect rank under Ning Zhu's regency, with promotion to full prefect if he proved able. They asked to rename the new seal to prevent forgery. The throne declined a rename; otherwise the plan stood. Wusa, Yongning, Wumeng, Zhanyi, and Shuixi had long been intermarried neighbors; later private feuds spawned endless accusations, as the Yongning biography records, exhausting officials. In Wanli 6 the court ordered fines in the tribal ox-penalty custom to end feuds and protect the people, yet peace never held.
21
三十八年詔東川土司並聽雲南節制。 時巡按鄧氵美疏稱：「蜀之東川逼處武定、尋甸諸郡，只隔一嶺，出沒無時，朝發夕至。 其酋長祿壽、祿哲兄弟，安忍無親，日尋幹戈。 其部落以劫殺為生，不事耕作。 蜀轄遼遠，法紀易疏。 滇以非我屬內，號令不行。 以是驕蹇成習，目無漢法。 今惟改敕滇撫兼制東川。 」因條三利以進，詔從之。
In the thirty-eighth year Dongchuan's native prefect was placed under Yunnan's jurisdiction. Inspector Deng Mei wrote: "Shu's Dongchuan borders Wuding and Xundian across a single ridge—raiders could strike at dawn and withdraw by dusk, Its chiefs Lu Shou and Lu Zhe were pitiless kin-slayers, ever at war. Their people lived by raiding, not by farming. Sichuan's reach was too distant to enforce the law. Yunnan, treating the area as outside its domain, issued no orders. Thus arrogance became custom and Han law meant nothing to them. The remedy is to empower Yunnan's grand coordinator to supervise Dongchuan as well. " He enumerated three gains in a memorial, and the court assented.
22
先是，四川烏撒軍民府，雲南沾益州，雖滇、蜀異轄，宗派一源。 明初大軍南下，女土官實卜與夫弟阿哥二人，率眾歸順，授實卜以烏撒土知府，授阿哥以沾益土知州。 其後，彼絕此繼，通為一家。 萬歷元年，沾益女土官安素儀無嗣，奏以土知府祿墨次子繼本州，即安紹慶也。 已，祿墨及長子安雲龍與兩孫俱歿，安紹慶奏以次子安效良歸宗，襲土知府。 安雲龍之妻隴氏，即鎮雄女土官者氏之女也，以雲龍雖故，尚有遺孤，且挾外家兵力，與紹慶為敵。 紹慶則以隴氏所出，明系假子，亦倚沾益兵力，與隴氏為難。 彼此仇殺，流毒一方。 士民連名上奏，事行兩省會勘，歷十有四年不結。 是年，安雲翔奏稱：「隴氏有子官保，今已長成。 效良倚父兵，強圖竊據，殺戮無辜。 」因極言效良不可立者數事。
Earlier, Sichuan's Wusa and Yunnan's Zhanyi lay under different provinces yet sprang from a single clan line. When Hongwu's armies marched south, the female chieftain Shibo and her brother-in-law Age led their people in submission; Shibo received Wusa and Age Zhanyi. Thereafter the two lines intermarried until they became one house. In Wanli 1 An Suyi of Zhanyi died childless; the court approved Lu Mo's second son An Shaoqing to succeed her. When Lu Mo, his heir Yunlong, and two grandsons all died, Shaoqing petitioned for his younger son Xiaoliang to return to the clan line and inherit Wusa. Yunlong's widow Lady Long—daughter of Zhenxiong's chieftainess Zheshi—claimed a posthumous heir and, backed by her family's troops, warred against Shaoqing. Shaoqing denounced the Long child as a bastard and rallied Zhanyi forces against her. They raided and slaughtered each other until the whole country suffered. Local leaders petitioned jointly; Sichuan and Yunnan conducted a joint inquiry that dragged on fourteen years without resolution. That year Yunxiang reported: "Lady Long's son Guanbao has come of age. Xiaoliang, backed by his father's troops, sought to seize power by force and butchered innocents. " He listed several reasons why Xiaoliang must not succeed.
23
三十九年，廷臣議行川、貴大吏勘報。 貴州撫臣以土官爭職在雲南，而為害在黔、蜀，必得三省會勘，始可定獄。 帝命速勘，乃命隴鶴書承襲鎮雄土知府。 鶴書，原名阿卜，自其始祖隴飛沙獻土歸順，授為世職知府，五傳而為庶魯卜，別居於果利地，又四傳而為庶祿姑，別居夷良、七欠頭地，又五傳而隴氏之正支斬矣。 水西安堯臣贅於祿，欲奄有之，眾論不平，始有驅安立隴之奏，奉旨察立隴後。 女官者氏以阿固應。 阿固者，魯卜之六世孫，而易名隴正名者也。 於是主立阿固，而先立其父阿章。 章尋病死，阿固不為夷眾所服，往復察勘。 者氏及四十八目、十五火頭等共推阿卜。 阿卜者，祿姑之五世孫，鹹以為長且賢，而者氏且以印獻，遂定立阿卜，而以阿固充管事，從巡撫喬應星之議也。
In the thirty-ninth year the court ordered senior officials in Sichuan and Guizhou to investigate. Guizhou's governor argued that while the succession dispute lay in Yunnan, the suffering fell on Guizhou and Sichuan—only a three-province inquiry could settle the case. The emperor demanded a swift inquiry and appointed Long Heshu Zhenxiong's native prefect. Heshu, born Abu, descended from Long Feisha, who submitted his domain and received a hereditary prefecture. Five generations later a branch settled at Guoli; four generations after that another branch at Yiliang and Qiqian; five generations on, the main Long line died out. An Yao of Shuixi married into the Lu line and sought to seize Zhenxiong; popular opinion rebelled, prompting a petition to replace the An with a Long heir, which the throne ordered investigated. Chieftainess Zheshi nominated Agu. Agu was Lubu's sixth-generation descendant, later renamed Long Zhengming. They proposed Agu, but installed his father Azhang first. Azhang soon died; the Yi tribes rejected Agu, and the inquiry reopened. Zheshi, forty-eight mu chiefs, and fifteen fire-heads together backed Abu. Abu, fifth in descent from Lugu, was judged eldest and able; Zheshi surrendered the seal; Abu was confirmed prefect and Agu made steward, as Grand Coordinator Qiao Yingxing had advised.
24
四十一年，烏撒土舍安效良初與安雲翔爭立，朝廷以嫡派立效良。 雲翔數為亂，謀逐效良，焚劫烏撒。 四川撫按上其事，以效良為雲龍親侄，雲翔乃其堂弟，親疏判然，效良自當立。 雲翔擾害地方，欺罔朝廷，罪原難赦，但為奸人指使，情可原，姑準復冠帶。 從之。
In the forty-first year Xiaoliang and Yunxiang fought over Wusa; the court favored the direct heir Xiaoliang. Yunxiang repeatedly rebelled, plotting to oust Xiaoliang and ravaging Wusa. Sichuan's civil and military commissioners reported that Xiaoliang, Yunlong's nephew, stood closer in kinship than cousin Yunxiang and thus deserved the post. Yunxiang had ravaged the region and defied the throne—capitally culpable—yet as another's puppet he was spared and allowed to resume his rank. The court agreed.
25
四十三年，雲南巡按吳應琦言：「東川土官祿壽、祿哲爭襲以來，各縱部眾，越境劫掠。 擁眾千余，剽掠兩府，浹旬之間，村屯並掃，荼毒未有如此之甚者。 或撫或剿，毋令養禍日滋。 」下所司勘奏。 貴州巡按御史楊鶴言：「烏撒土官，自安雲龍物故，安咀與安效良爭官奪印，仇殺者二十年。 夷民無統，盜寇蜂起，堡屯焚毀，行賈梗絕者亦二十年。 是爭官奪印者蜀之土官，而蹂踐糜爛者黔之赤子。 誠改隸於黔，則彈壓既便，幹戈可戢。 」又言：「烏撒者，滇、蜀之咽喉要地。 臣由普安入滇，七日始達烏撒。 見效良之父安紹慶據沾益，當曲靖之門戶。 效良據烏撒，又扼滇、蜀之咽喉。 父子各據一方，且壤地相接，無他郡縣上司以隔絕鈐制之，將來尾大不掉，實可寒心。 蓋黔有可制之勢，而無其權； 蜀有遙制之名，而無其實。 誠以為隸黔中便。 」帝命所司速議。
In the forty-third year Yunnan censor Wu Yingqi wrote: "Since Lu Shou and Lu Zhe of Dongchuan began fighting over the succession, each has let his followers raid across the border. Leading over a thousand men, they ravaged both prefectures; within ten days whole villages were wiped out—never had the harm been so grave. Pacify or suppress them—do not let the trouble fester. " The court referred the case to the relevant offices for investigation. Guizhou censor Yang He wrote: "Since Yunlong of Wusa died, Ju and Xiaoliang have fought twenty years over the seal and succession. The tribes lacked leadership; bandits swarmed; forts burned and trade halted—for twenty years. Sichuan's chieftains fought over the seal, but Guizhou's common people paid the price. Transfer Wusa to Guizhou's jurisdiction and control becomes easier and the fighting may cease. " He added: "Wusa is the strategic throat between Yunnan and Sichuan. I entered Yunnan through Pu'an and did not reach Wusa until the seventh day. I found Xiaoliang's father Shaoqing holding Zhanyi, the gateway to Qujing. Xiaoliang held Wusa, commanding the pass between the two provinces. Father and son each held a stronghold on contiguous land with no intervening authority to restrain them—a classic recipe for a power that the court could not control. Guizhou was positioned to control them but lacked the authority; Sichuan had nominal oversight but no real power. Placing Wusa under Guizhou would be the wiser course. " The emperor ordered a prompt decision from the ministries.
26
泰昌元年，雲南撫按沈儆炌等言：蜀之東川，業奉朝命兼制，然事權全不相關。 祿千鐘、祿阿伽縱賊披猖，為患不已。 是東川雖隸蜀，而相去甚遠，雖不隸滇，而禍實震鄰。 宜特敕蜀撫按，凡遇襲替，務合兩省會勘。 蜀察其世次，滇亦按無侵犯，方許起送，亦羈縻綏靜之要術也。 」詔下所司。 時諸土司皆桀驁難制，烏撒、東川、烏蒙、鎮雄諸府地界，復相錯於川、滇、黔、楚之間，統轄既分，事權不一，往往軼出為諸邊害。 故封疆大吏紛紛陳情，冀安邊隅，而中樞之臣動諉勘報，彌年經月，卒無成畫，以致疆事日壞。 播州初平，永寧又叛，水西煽起，東川、烏蒙、鎮雄皆觀望騎墻，心懷疑二。 於是安效良以烏撒首附逆於邦彥，並力攻陸廣，復合沾益賊圍羅平，陷沾益，為雲南巡撫閔洪學所敗。 洪學以兵力不繼，好語招之，令擒賊自贖，效良亦佯為恭順。 又見黔師出陸廣，滇師出沾益，水、烏之勢已成騎虎，遂合永寧、水西諸部三十六營，直抵沾益，對壘城下五日。 副總兵袁善、宣撫使沙源等督將士力戰，出奇兵破之，效良敗死。 妻安氏無子，妾設白生其爵、其祿。 二婦素不相能，安氏居鹽倉，設白母子居抱渡。 安氏遂代效良為土官，然亦未絕其爵，其爵亦以安氏為安位姐，不敢抗。
In Taichang 1 Yunnan's civil and military commissioners Shen Jingcan and others reported that although Dongchuan nominally fell under joint Sichuan–Yunnan control, the two sides exercised no real authority over each other. Lu Qianzhong and Lu Aga unleashed raiders whose depredations never ceased. Dongchuan belonged to Sichuan but lay too far for effective rule; though outside Yunnan's jurisdiction, its troubles battered the neighboring province. Sichuan's commissioners should be ordered that every succession require joint investigation by both provinces. Sichuan should verify the line of descent and Yunnan confirm no encroachment before an heir was installed—a key method of indirect rule. " The throne referred the matter to the ministries. Every native prefecture had grown unruly; Wusa, Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong straddled Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, and Huguang with divided oversight and conflicting authority, and their feuds repeatedly spilled into the frontier. Frontier governors pleaded for relief, but central officials deferred to endless inquiries; months and years passed without a settled policy, and the border situation grew worse daily. Hardly was Bozhou pacified when Yongning rebelled and Shuixi rose; Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong hedged their bets, torn between loyalty and revolt. An Xiaoliang of Wusa was first among the chieftains to join She Bangyan's rebellion, attacked Luguang with him, then allied with Zhanyi rebels to besiege Luoping and seize Zhanyi before Yunnan Grand Coordinator Min Hongxue defeated him. Short of troops, Hongxue offered fair terms and promised redemption if Xiaoliang captured the rebels; Xiaoliang feigned submission. Seeing Guizhou troops advance from Luguang and Yunnan troops from Zhanyi, the Shuixi–Wusa alliance found itself unable to dismount; he rallied thirty-six camps of Yongning and Shuixi, marched on Zhanyi, and camped beneath its walls for five days. Vice Commander Yuan Shan and Pacification Commissioner Sha Yuan led a fierce counterattack with a surprise force; Xiaoliang was routed and killed. His wife Lady An bore no sons; concubine Shebai bore Qi Jue and Qi Lu. The two women had long been at odds; Lady An held Yancang while Shebai and her sons held Baodu. Lady An succeeded Xiaoliang as chieftain but did not disown Qi Jue, who treated her as his elder kinswoman An Wei and did not resist.
27
二年，總督朱燮元調集漢土兵，列營沾益，趣滇撫會兵進烏撒境。 安邊、安氏逃避偏橋。 大兵入鹽倉，拔難民一千余人。 師還，安邊、安氏復還鹽倉，遣人至軍前，請俟烏城克復，束身歸命，意實緩師。 乃復發兵逐安邊、安氏，以鹽倉授其爵。 兵至望城坡，遇賊哨騎百余，麾兵奮擊，賊盡奔箐中，遂復烏撒城。 安邊駐三十里外，擁兵求見，諭令束身歸誠。 邊夜遁，遂棄鹽倉，入九龍囤。 烏撒陷賊八年，至是始復。 乃召其爵來鹽倉，令約束九頭目以守，且令圖獻安邊、安氏。 其爵以鹽倉殘毀，乞移烏撒城，從之。 時其爵署烏撒知府，其祿署沾益知州，雖懦稚頗忠順，其母亦頗有主持，能得眾。 安邊屢乞降於總督朱燮元，用藉水西安位代申，以邊實紹慶嫡孫，宜襲知州，請罪其爵、其祿。 燮元曲為調護，欲予以職銜，分烏撒安置之。 雲南撫按堅執不可，以安邊令其黨勒兵於野馬川，復以千金誘其爵頭目，日為並吞沾、烏計。 萬一其爵被襲，則烏撒失，而前功盡棄。 烏撒失，沾益危，而全滇動搖，非但震鄰，實乃切膚。 竟不行。 安邊乃乞師於安位，納之沾益，而逐其祿，時安氏在也。 既而安氏死。 安位與之貳，其祿乃假手羅彩令者布發難，邊遄死。 不移日，其祿率兵至，詭言為其叔報仇，士民歸者如流，於是其祿復有沾益。 而廟堂之上方急流寇，不復能問雲。
In the second year Governor Zhu Xieyuan assembled Chinese and native troops, encamped at Zhanyi, and pressed the Yunnan governor to join the advance into Wusa. An Bian and Lady An fled to Pianqiao. Government troops entered Yancang and rescued over a thousand refugees. After the army withdrew, Bian and Lady An returned to Yancang and sent envoys promising to surrender once Wusa city was taken—an obvious attempt to stall the campaign. Troops were sent again to expel Bian and Lady An, and Yancang was given to Qi Jue. At Wangcheng Slope they met a hundred rebel scouts, routed them into the ravines, and recovered Wusa city. An Bian camped thirty li away with an armed escort and requested an audience; he was ordered to surrender. Bian fled by night, abandoned Yancang, and took refuge in Jiulong Stockade. Wusa had been in rebel hands for eight years; only now was it restored. Qi Jue was summoned to Yancang, charged with the nine headmen to hold the place, and ordered to capture Bian and Lady An. Qi Jue, finding Yancang in ruins, asked to relocate to Wusa city; the request was granted. Qi Jue served as acting Wusa prefect and Qi Lu as Zhanyi magistrate; though young and mild, they were loyal, and their mother commanded the people's respect. An Bian repeatedly petitioned Zhu Xieyuan through An Wei of Shuixi, claiming that as Shaoqing's legitimate grandson he should inherit Zhanyi and demanding punishment for Qi Jue and Qi Lu. Xieyuan sought a compromise, offering Bian a title and a separate settlement within Wusa. Yunnan's commissioners refused, noting that Bian had massed troops at Yemachuan and offered a thousand taels of gold to bribe Qi Jue's headmen in a daily campaign to seize Zhanyi and Wusa. If Qi Jue were overrun, Wusa would be lost and all prior gains undone. Loss of Wusa would endanger Zhanyi and shake all Yunnan—not a distant threat but a wound at the heart of the province. The proposal was rejected. Bian then enlisted An Wei, installed him in Zhanyi, and expelled Qi Lu while Lady An still lived. Lady An soon died. An Wei turned against him; Qi Lu had the chieftain Luocai Lingzhebu provoke a clash, and Bian was killed at once. Within days Qi Lu marched in, claiming to avenge his uncle; the people flocked to him and he recovered Zhanyi. But the court was consumed by the roaming-bandit crisis and could no longer attend to Yunnan.
28
馬湖，漢牂牁郡內地也，有龍馬湖，因名焉。 唐為羈縻州四，總名馬湖部。 洪武四年冬，馬湖路總管安濟，遣其子仁來歸附，詔改馬湖路為馬湖府。 領長官司四：「曰泥溪，曰平夷，曰蠻夷，曰沐川。 以安濟為知府，世襲。 六年，安濟以病告，乞以子安仁代職，詔從之。 自是，三年一入貢。 七年，馬湖知府瑉德遣其弟阿穆上表貢馬，廷臣言：「洪武四年，大兵下蜀，瑉德叔安濟遣子入朝，朝廷授以世襲知府，恩至渥矣。 今瑉德既襲其職，不自來朝而遣其弟，非奉上之道。 」帝卻其所貢馬。 十二年，瑉德貢香楠木，詔賜衣鈔。 十六年，瑉德來朝，獻馬十八匹，賜衣一襲、米二十石、鈔三十錠。
Mahu lay within the Han dynasty's Zangge commandery and took its name from Dragon-Horse Lake. Under the Tang it comprised four indirectly ruled prefectures known collectively as the Mahu district. In winter of Hongwu 4 Mahu chief An Ji sent his son Ren to submit; the court renamed Mahu Circuit Mahu Prefecture. It oversaw four native magistracies: "Nixi, Pingyi, Manyi, and Muchuan. An Ji was appointed prefect in a hereditary office. In the sixth year An Ji, citing illness, asked that his son An Ren succeed him; the court agreed. Thereafter tribute was sent every three years. In the seventh year Mahu Prefect Minde sent his brother Amu to present horses; ministers observed: "In Hongwu 4, when the army conquered Shu, Minde's uncle An Ji sent his son to court and received a hereditary prefecture—the favor was extraordinary. Minde has succeeded to the post yet sends his brother instead of appearing in person—this is not how one serves the throne. " The emperor rejected the horses. In the twelfth year Minde presented fragrant nanmu timber; the court rewarded him with robes and cash. In the sixteenth year Minde came to court with eighteen horses and received a robe, twenty shi of grain, and thirty ingots of cash.
29
永樂十二年，泥溪、平夷、蠻夷、沐川四長官司遣人貢方物，賜鈔幣。 宣德八年，平夷長官司奏，比者火延公廨，凡朝廷頒降榜文、倉庫稅糧錢帛及案牘皆救免，乞宥罪，並獻馬二匹。 帝曰：「遠蠻能恭謹畏法如此。 」置不問。 正統二年，泥溪土官醫學正科田璣盜官藏絲鈔，援永、宣時例，邊夷有犯，聽以馬贖，許之。 三年，免馬湖府舉人王有學棄吏。 先是，有學會試，過期不至，例充吏。 有學原籍長官司，因遣通事貢馬，乞宥罪，仍肄習太學，許之。
In Yongle 12 the four magistracies of Nixi, Pingyi, Manyi, and Muchuan sent tribute; the court granted cash. In Xuande 8 the Pingyi magistracy reported that fire had lately consumed the yamen; court proclamations, tax records, treasury accounts, and archives were all lost in the blaze; they begged forgiveness and presented two horses. The emperor remarked, "Even distant tribes can show such reverence for the law." He let the matter drop. In Zhengtong 2 Tian Ji, medical graduate of the Nixi chieftaincy, stole silk and banknotes from the government stores; invoking the Yongle-Xuande rule allowing frontier tribesmen to commute offenses with horses, the court granted leave. In year 3 Wang Youxue, a Mahu presented scholar, was excused from demotion to clerical service. Previously Youxue had entered the metropolitan exam but failed to appear in time and was by rule reduced to a clerk. A native of a frontier magistracy, he sent an interpreter with horses as tribute, pleaded for pardon, and asked to resume study at the academy; the request was granted.
30
弘治八年，土知府安鰲有罪，伏誅。 鰲性殘忍虐民，計口賦錢，歲入銀萬計。 土民有婦女，多淫之。 用妖僧百足魘魅殺人。 又令人殺平夷長官王大慶，大慶聞而逃，乃殺其弟。 為橫二十年。 巡按御史張鸞請治之，得實，伏誅，遂改馬湖府為流官知府。
In Hongzhi 8 the indigenous prefect An Ao was found guilty and put to death. Ao was cruel and oppressed his people with a per-capita levy yielding ten thousand taels a year. He routinely abused the wives and daughters of his subjects. He employed a sham monk's centipede sorcery to murder his enemies. He also sent assassins after Wang Daqing, the Pingyi magistrate; Daqing fled on warning, so they slew his brother instead. He had tyrannized the region for twenty years. Censor Zhang Luan moved to prosecute him; once the charges proved true, An Ao was executed and Mahu converted to direct prefectural administration.
31
建昌衛 〈 （寧番衛越巂衛鹽井衛會川衛）〉
The Jianchang Guard ( (Ningfan, Yuexi, Yanjing, and Huichuan guards)
32
建昌衛，本邛都地。 漢武帝置越巂郡。 隋、唐皆為巂州。 至德初，沒於吐番。 貞元中收復。 懿宗時，為蒙詔所據，改建昌府，以烏、白二蠻實之。 元至元間，置建昌路，又立羅羅斯宣慰司以統之。
Jianchang Guard occupied the ancient land of Qiongdu. Emperor Wu of Han created the commandery of Yuexi. Under the Sui and Tang it was known as Xi Prefecture. Early in the Zhide era it fell to Tibet. It was retaken during the Zhenyuan reign. Under Emperor Yizong the Nanzhao seized it, founded Jianchang prefecture, and settled it with the Black and White Yi. Under the Yuan a Jianchang circuit was created, with a Luolosi pacification commission placed over it.
33
洪武五年，羅羅斯宣慰安定來朝，而建昌尚未歸附，十四年遣內臣賫敕諭之，乃降。 十五年置建昌衛指揮使司。 元平章月魯帖木兒等自雲南建昌來貢馬一百八十匹，並上元所授符印。 詔賜月魯帖木兒綺衣、金帶、靴襪，家人綿布一百六十疋、鈔二千四百四十錠。 以月魯帖木兒為建昌衛指揮使，月給三品俸贍其家。 十六年，建昌土官安配及土酋阿派先後來朝，貢馬及方物，皆賜織金文綺、衣帽、靴襪。 十八年，月魯帖木兒舉家來朝，請遣子入學，厚賜遣之。 二十一年，建昌府故土官安思正妻師克等來朝，貢馬九十九匹。 詔授師克知府，賜冠帶、襲衣、文綺、鈔錠，因命師克討東川、芒部及赤水河叛蠻。 二十三年，安配遣子僧保等四十二人入監讀書。 二十五年，致仕指揮安配貢馬，詔賜配及其把事五十三人幣紗有差。
In Hongwu 5 Commissioner Anding of Luolosi presented tribute, but Jianchang had not yet submitted; in year 14 the court sent a eunuch with an edict, and the region surrendered. In year 15 the Jianchang Guard command was established. Former Yuan grand councillor Yuelutiemuer and others came from Jianchang in Yunnan with one hundred eighty horses and surrendered their Yuan seals of office. The court granted Yuelutiemuer brocade robes, a gold belt, boots and hose, and for his household one hundred sixty bolts of cotton cloth and two thousand four hundred forty ingots of cash. Yuelutiemuer was appointed commander of Jianchang Guard with a third-rank stipend to support his household. In year 16 the Jianchang chieftain An Pei and the tribal leader A Pai came in turn to court with horses and local goods; each received brocade, caps and robes, and boots. In year 18 Yuelutiemuer brought his entire family to court and asked that his son enter the imperial school; the court lavished gifts and sent them home. In year 21 Shike, widow of the former Jianchang chieftain An Sizheng, came to court with ninety-nine horses. The court named Shike prefect, granted regalia and cash, and ordered her to suppress rebels in Dongchuan, Mangbu, and along the Chishui River. In year 23 An Pei sent his son Sengbao and forty-one others to study at the imperial college. In year 25 the retired commander An Pei sent horses; the court granted him and his fifty-three retainers gifts of silk in graded amounts.
34
已而月魯帖木兒反，合德昌、會川、迷易、柏興、邛部並西番土軍萬余人，殺官軍男婦二百余口，掠屯牛，燒營屋，劫軍糧，率眾攻城。 指揮使安的以所部兵出戰，敗之，斬八十余級，擒其黨十余人。 賊退屯阿宜河，轉攻蘇州。 指揮僉事魯毅率精騎出西門擊之，賊眾大集，毅且戰且卻，復入城拒守。 賊圍城，毅乘間遣壯士王旱突入賊營，斫賊，賊驚遁。 於是置建昌、蘇州二軍民指揮使司及會川軍民千戶所，調京衛及陜西兵萬五千余人往戍之。 仍諭將士互相應援，設伏出奇，並諭擒賊首獻者賞千金。 復諭總兵官涼國公藍玉，以月魯帖木兒詭詐，不可信其降，致緩師養禍。 四川都指揮使瞿能率各衛兵至雙狼寨，擒偽千戶段太平等，賊眾大潰，月魯帖木兒敗遁。 能督兵追捕，攻托落寨，拔之。 轉戰而前，進至打沖河三里所，與月魯帖木兒遇，大戰，又敗之。 俘其眾五百余人，溺死者千余，獲牛馬無算。 官軍入德昌，能遂調指揮同知徐凱分兵入普濟州搜捕。 復駕橋於打沖河，遣指揮李華引兵追托落寨余孽，進至水西，斬月魯帖木兒把事七人，其截路寨土蠻長沙、納的皆中矢死。 能還攻天星、臥漂諸寨，皆克之，先後俘殺千八百余人。 月魯帖木兒遁入柏興州。
Soon Yuelutiemuer rose in revolt, rallying more than ten thousand men from Dechang, Huichuan, Miyi, Baixing, Qiongbu, and allied Tibetan tribes; they slew over two hundred soldiers and dependents, looted cattle, burned camps, seized grain stores, and besieged the city. Commander An De marched out, routed the rebels, took more than eighty heads, and captured a dozen ringleaders. The rebels fell back to Ayi River and then struck at Suzhou. Assistant Commander Lu Yi led picked horsemen out the west gate; when the rebels massed he fought a fighting withdrawal and sealed the gates. While the city was besieged, Lu Yi sent the warrior Wang Han on a night raid into the rebel camp; the enemy panicked and fled. The court then created military-civilian commands at Jianchang and Suzhou and a Huichuan battalion, and dispatched fifteen thousand troops from the capital garrisons and Shaanxi to hold them. Officers were ordered to coordinate, set ambushes, and strike by surprise; whoever delivered the rebel leader's head would receive a thousand taels of gold. Lan Yu, Duke of Liang and supreme commander, was warned that Yuelutiemuer was treacherous and that any offer of surrender must not delay operations and allow the rebellion to fester. Regional Commander Qu Neng of Sichuan led the garrison troops to Shuanglang Stockade, seized the pretender battalion chief Duan Taiping and others, routed the main rebel force, and drove Yuelutiemuer into flight. Neng pressed the pursuit, stormed Tuoluo Stockade, and captured it. Fighting his way forward to within three li of the Dachong River, he met Yuelutiemuer in pitched battle and defeated him again. He took more than five hundred prisoners; over a thousand drowned; cattle and horses captured beyond count. As the army entered Dechang, Neng detached Assistant Commander Xu Kai to scour Puji prefecture. A bridge was thrown across the Dachong River and Commander Li Hua pursued the survivors of Tuoluo Stockade; reaching the west bank he slew seven of Yuelutiemuer's lieutenants, and the tribal chiefs Changsha and Nade of Jielu Stockade fell to arrows. Neng then stormed Tianxing, Wopiao, and neighboring stockades, taking them all and killing or capturing more than eighteen hundred rebels. Yuelutiemuer took refuge in Baixing.
35
帝遣諭藍玉曰：「月魯帖木兒信其逆黨達達、楊把事等，或遣之先降，或親來覘我，不可不密為防。 其柏興州賈哈喇境內麼些等部，更須留意。 」賈哈喇者，麼些洞土酋也。 初，王師克建昌，授以指揮之職，自是從月魯帖木兒叛。 玉率兵至柏興州，遣百戶毛海以計誘致月魯帖木兒並其子胖伯，遂降其眾，送月魯帖木兒京師，伏誅。 玉因奏：「四川地曠山險，控扼西番。 松、茂、碉、黎當吐番出入之地，馬湖、建昌、嘉定俱為要道，皆宜增屯衛。 」報可，命玉班師。
The emperor warned Lan Yu: "Yuelutiemuer may send his lieutenants Dada and Yangbashi to feign surrender, or come himself to reconnoiter—take every precaution." Pay special heed to the Mosuo and other tribes in the Jiahalazhe district of Baixing. Jiahalazhe was a Mosuo cave chieftain. When the imperial army first took Jianchang he had been made a commander, but he then joined Yuelutiemuer's revolt. Lan Yu marched into Baixing and sent Centurion Mao Hai to lure Yuelutiemuer and his son Pangbo into capture; the rebels submitted, Yuelutiemuer was sent to the capital and executed. Lan Yu then memorialized: "Sichuan is vast and mountainous, a choke point against the western tribes." Song, Mao, Diao, and Li mark Tibetan ingress; Mahu, Jianchang, and Jiading are vital corridors—all warrant reinforced garrisons." The memorial was approved and Lan Yu ordered to withdraw.
36
二十七年，麼些洞蠻寇打沖河西守堡，都督徐凱擊敗之。 二十九年，威龍土知州普習叛。 普習，月魯帖木兒妻兄也。 官軍捕之，普習中流矢死。 三十一年，徐凱等平卜木瓦寨，執賈哈喇，送京師，誅之。 寨地峻險，三百陡絕，下臨大江，江流悍急，不可行舟，惟一道僅可通人行。 官軍至，輒自上投石，不得進。 凱乃斷其汲道困之，寇窮促，凱督將士抵其寨，力攻破之，遂就擒。 因改建昌路為建昌衛，置軍民指揮使司。 安氏世襲指揮使，不給印，置其居於城東郭外里許。 所屬有四十八馬站，大頭土番、僰人子、白夷、麼些、作佫鹿、倮羅、韃靼、回紇諸種散居山谷間。 北至大渡，南及金沙江，東抵烏蒙，西訖鹽井，延袤千餘里。 以昌州、普濟、威龍三州長官隸之，有把事四人，世轄其眾，皆節制於四川行都指揮使司。 西南土官，安氏殆為稱首。 配六世孫安忠無後，妻鳳氏管指揮使事。 鳳氏死，族人安登繼襲，復無子，妻瞿氏管事，以族人世隆嗣。 世隆復無子，繼妻祿氏管事。 祿死，以族侄安崇業嗣。 崇業與祿氏不相能，因養那固為假子，其奴祿祈從臾構難，歲仇殺。 鎮巡官讞之，殺那固而戍祿祈，事遂平。 安氏所轄四驛，曰祿馬、阿用、白水、瀘沽，各百里有差。 其涼山拖郎、桐槽、熱水諸番，則以強弱為向背。 所領昌州等三長官司，皆在衛東、西、南三百里內。 洪武十八年，土官盧尼姑、吉撒加、白氐等歸附，皆令世襲為知州。 月魯帖木兒之亂，諸州皆廢革。 永樂元年復置，悉改為長官司，仍隸建昌。 其千戶所之隸於衛者有三：曰禮州，曰打沖河，曰德昌。 禮州，漢蘇示縣； 打沖河，唐沙野城； 德昌，元定昌路也。
In year 27 Mosuo tribesmen attacked the fort west of the Dachong River; Regional Commander Xu Kai repulsed them. In year 29 Puxi, indigenous prefect of Weilong, rose in revolt. Puxi was the elder brother of Yuelutiemuer's wife. Government troops hunted him down; Puxi fell to an arrow. In year 31 Xu Kai stormed Bumuwa Stockade, captured Jiahalazhe, sent him to the capital, and had him executed. The stockade stood on cliffs three hundred zhang high above a torrent where no boat could sail; only a single footpath gave access. Whenever troops approached, defenders rolled stones from the heights and blocked the path. Kai cut off their water supply; when the rebels were desperate he led his men up the path, stormed the stockade, and took Jiahalazhe alive. Jianchang circuit was then converted to a guard with a military-civilian command. The An family held the command as a hereditary post without an official seal, dwelling just east of the city wall. Its jurisdiction held forty-eight relay stations; Datu Tibetans, Bo peoples, White Yi, Mosuo, Zuobailu, Lolo, Mongols, and Uyghurs lived scattered through the valleys. It stretched from the Dadu River in the north to the Jinsha in the south, from Wumeng in the east to Yanjing in the west—over a thousand li across. The magistrates of Chang, Puji, and Weilong answered to it, with four hereditary lieutenants ruling their peoples, all under the Sichuan regional command. Among the southwestern chieftains the An clan ranked foremost. An Zhong, sixth-generation descendant of Pei, died without heirs, and his wife Lady Feng administered the command. After Lady Feng's death clansman An Deng inherited but also died childless; his widow Lady Qu governed until clansman Shilong was named successor. Shilong too died without heirs, and his widow Lady Lu took charge. When Lady Lu died, her husband's nephew An Chongye was named heir. Chongye quarreled with Lady Lu, adopted Nagu as his heir, and his servant Lu Qi stirred up trouble until the two sides killed one another year after year. The patrol official tried the case, executed Nagu, and exiled Lu Qi to military service, and peace was restored. The An domain held four relay stations—Luma, Ayong, Baishui, and Lugu—roughly a hundred li apart. The Liangshan tribes of Tuolang, Tongcao, and Reshui shifted allegiance according to who held the upper hand. The three subordinate magistracies of Chang and the others all lay within three hundred li east, west, and south of the guard. In Hongwu 18 the chieftains Lu Nigu, Jisajia, Baishi, and others submitted and were confirmed as hereditary prefects. During Yuelutiemuer's revolt all three prefectures were abolished. In Yongle 1 they were re-established as native magistracies under Jianchang. Three battalion districts answered to the guard: Lizhou, Dachong River, and Dechang. Lizhou had been the Han county of Sushi; Dachong River, the Tang fortress of Shaye; Dechang, the Yuan Dingchang circuit.
37
寧番衛，元時立於邛都之野，曰蘇州。 洪武間，土官怕兀它從月魯帖木兒為亂，廢州置衛。 環而居者，皆西番種，故曰寧番。 有冕山、鎮西、禮州中三千戶所。
Ningfan Guard was founded in Yuan times in the Qiongdu plain as Suzhou. During Hongwu the chieftain Pawuta joined Yuelutiemuer's revolt; the prefecture was abolished and replaced by a guard. Surrounding tribes were all of the western barbarian peoples, hence the name Ningfan, Pacify the Barbarians. It had battalion districts at Mianshan, Zhenxi, and Central Lizhou.
38
越巂衛，漢邛都及闌二縣地。 有奴諾城，即蜀漢時諸葛亮征蠻所築以憩軍者也。 元置邛部安撫招討司，已，改邛部州。 洪武中，嶺真伯以招討使來歸，因改為邛部軍民州。 洪武二十五年置越巂軍民指揮使司於邛部州，命指揮僉事李質領謫戍軍士守之。 二十六年置越巂衛。 永樂元年改邛部為長官司，隸越巂衛。 萬歷中，土官嶺柏死，孽子應升負印去，柏妾沙氏爭之不得。 土目阿堆等擁沙氏，焚利濟站廬舍，擁兵臨城。 總兵劉顯率兵往撫之，沙氏悔禍，殺阿堆等自贖，顯遂以印授之。 後沙氏淫於族人阿祭，印復為升所奪。 祭死。 其子嶺鳳起嗾他番刺殺應升。 鎮守官因平蠻之師，誘鳳起縶之，收其印，而誅從鳳起為亂者百余人。 印無所歸，緘於庫。 部眾無統，肆行為盜。 普雄部眾姑咱等乘勢蜂起，郵傳不通，遠近震恐。 十五年，鎮巡官會師討之，斬馘千數，鳳起病死，其眾爭歸附，因置平夷、歸化二堡以居之。 有鎮西千戶所。
Yuexi Guard occupied the Han counties of Qiongdu and Lan. It held Nunuo city, which Zhuge Liang had built during his southern campaigns to quarter his troops. The Yuan first created a Qiongbu pacification commission, later redesignated Qiongbu prefecture. During Hongwu Commissioner Lingzhenbo submitted and the region became the Qiongbu military-civilian prefecture. In Hongwu 25 a Yuexi military-civilian command was placed at Qiongbu, with Assistant Commander Li Zhi leading exiled garrison troops to hold it. In year 26 the Yuexi Guard was created. In Yongle 1 Qiongbu became a native magistracy under Yuexi Guard. During Wanli the chieftain Ling Bai died; his bastard son Yingsheng seized the seal and fled, and Bai's concubine Lady Sha failed to recover it. Native headman Adui and his followers backed Lady Sha, torched Liji courier station, and marched on the city. Regional commander Liu Xian marched to pacify them; Lady Sha repented, executed Adui and his men to atone, and Liu restored the seal to her. Later she took her kinsman Aji as lover, and Yingsheng seized the seal again. Aji died. His son Ling Fengqi hired other tribesmen to murder Yingsheng. The garrison commander, while troops were pacifying the tribes, lured Fengqi into custody, recovered the seal, and executed over a hundred of his followers. With no rightful holder, the seal was locked in the treasury. Leaderless, the clansmen turned to brigandage. Puxiong tribesmen led by Guzan rose in a swarm; post roads were severed and the region was gripped by panic. In year fifteen touring officials mustered troops, killed thousands, and Fengqi died of illness; his people rushed to submit, and the court built the forts Pingyi and Guihua to resettle them. It had a Zhenxi battalion office.
39
鹽井衛，古定笮縣也。 元初為落蘭部。 至元中，於黑、白鹽井置閏鹽縣，於縣置柏興府。 洪武中，改為柏興千戶所，旋改鹽井衛，又於二井置鹽課司。 永樂五年設馬剌長官司； 其村落多白夷居之。 長官民阿氏，洪武時歸附，授世職。 地接雲南北勝州，稱庶富，人亦擾馴。
Yanjing Guard occupied the old territory of Dingzuo county. Under the early Yuan it was the Luolan tribe. In the Zhiyuan era the court created Runyan county at the black and white salt wells and Boxing prefecture at the county seat. During Hongwu it became the Boxing battalion, then Yanjing Guard, with a salt-tax bureau at both wells. In Yongle 5 the court established the Mala native magistracy; whose villages were mostly Baiyi. Magistrate Min of the A clan submitted in Hongwu and received a hereditary office. It bordered Yunnan's Beisheng prefecture, was reckoned prosperous, and its people were restless but manageable.
40
打沖河守禦中左千戶所，其土千戶剌兀，於洪武二十五年征賈哈喇效順來歸。 其子馬剌非復貢馬赴京，授本所副千戶。 永樂十一年升正，以別於四所。 地與麗江、永寧二府鄰，麗江土官木氏侵削其地幾半。
At Dachong River garrison battalion the native chief La Wu submitted in Hongwu 25 after campaigning against Jia Hala. His son Mala Fei presented horses at court and was made deputy battalion chief. In Yongle 11 he was promoted to full rank, distinct from the four other offices. It bordered Lijiang and Yongning; the Mu chieftains of Lijiang had seized nearly half its territory.
41
會川衛，越巂之會無縣也。 唐上元中，移邛都縣於會川鎮，以川原並會故名。 宋屬大理，為會川府。 元置會川路，治武安州，隸羅羅斯宣慰司。 洪武十七年，會川土同知馬誠來朝，復立會川府，領武安、永昌、麻龍等州。 二十六年革會川府。 初，月魯帖木兒反，土知府王春陷會川，毀民居府治，至是遂墮其城。 尋改為會川衛軍民指揮使司，領迷易千戶所。 土官賢姓，其先雲南景東僰種也，徙其屬來田種。 洪武十六年歸附，以隨征東川、芒部勞，授世襲副千戶。 居所治城外，所轄僰蠻僅八百戶。
Huichuan Guard lay in old Huiwu county of Yuexi. In Tang Shangyuan Qiongdu county was moved to Huichuan town, named for the meeting of river and plain. Under Song it belonged to Dali as Huichuan prefecture. The Yuan made it Huichuan circuit, seat at Wu'an, under the Luoluo pacification commission. In Hongwu 17 native vice-prefect Ma Cheng of Huichuan came to court; the court restored Huichuan prefecture over Wu'an, Yongchang, Malong, and other districts. In year twenty-six Huichuan prefecture was abolished. Earlier Yue Lu Tie'er had rebelled; native prefect Wang Chun seized Huichuan, razed homes and the yamen, and the walls were left in ruins. It was soon made the Huichuan military-civilian command with the Miyi battalion under it. The native official surnamed Xian descended from Bo tribesmen of Jingdong, Yunnan, who migrated their people to farm. He submitted in Hongwu 16 and, for service in the Dongchuan and Mangbu campaigns, received a hereditary deputy battalion chiefship. He lived outside the walled seat and ruled barely eight hundred Bo households.
42
茂州，古冉龍國地。 漢武帝置汶山郡，宣帝為北部都尉。 隋為蜀州，尋改會州。 唐貞觀改茂州。 宋、元仍舊，治汶山縣。 洪武六年，茂州權知州楊者七及隴木頭、靜州、嶽希蓬諸土官來朝貢。 十一年置茂州衛指揮使司。 時四川都司遣兵修灌縣橋梁至陶關，汶川土酋孟道貴疑之，集部落阻陶關道。 都司遣指揮胡淵、童勝等統兵分二道擊之，一由石泉，一由灌口。 由灌口者進次陶關，蠻眾伏兩山間，投石崖下，兵不能進。 適汶川土官來降，得其間道。 乃選勇士卷旗甲，乘夜潛出兩山後，遲明從山頂張旗幟，發火炮，蠻驚潰。 師進雁門關，道險，蠻復據之。 乃駐平野，得小舟渡，至龍止鐵冶寨，擊破之。 其由石泉者次泥池，蠻悉眾拒。 千戶薛文突陣射卻之，士卒奮擊，大敗其眾。 兩軍遂會於茂州，楊者七迎降，以者七仍領其州。 乃詔立茂州衛，留指揮楚華將兵三千守之。 十五年，者七陰結生番，約日伏兵陷城。 有小校密告於官，遂發兵捕斬者七。 生番不之覺，如期入寇，官軍掩擊敗之，於是盡徙羌民於城外。
Maozhou was ancient Ranqiang country. Han Emperor Wu created Wenshan commandery; Emperor Xuan made it a northern frontier commandant district. Under Sui it was Shuzhou, soon renamed Huizhou. In Tang Zhenguan it became Maozhou. Song and Yuan kept the name, seat at Wenshan county. In Hongwu 6 acting prefect Yang Zheqi of Maozhou and chieftains of Longmutou, Jingzhou, Yuexipeng, and elsewhere presented tribute at court. In year eleven the Maozhou Guard command was established. The Sichuan command sent troops to repair bridges from Guan county to Taoguan; Wenchuan chief Meng Daogui suspected an attack, rallied his tribe, and blocked the road. It sent commanders Hu Yuan and Tong Sheng in two columns—one via Shiquan, one via Guankou. The Guankou force halted at Taoguan; tribesmen ambushed from both hillsides, rolling stones down the cliffs, and the troops could not pass. A Wenchuan chieftain then submitted and revealed a hidden path. Elite troops crept by night around both hills; at dawn they raised banners on the peaks, fired cannon, and the tribesmen broke and fled. The army reached Yanmen Pass, but the tribesmen held the treacherous defile again. They camped on open ground, crossed by boat, stormed Longzhi ironworks stockade, and broke it. The Shiquan column halted at Nichi, where the tribes mustered their full strength to resist. Battalion chief Xue Wen charged the line and drove them back; the troops pressed the attack and routed them. The columns united at Maozhou; Yang Zheqi submitted and was left to govern his prefecture. An edict established Maozhou Guard and left Commander Chu Hua with three thousand men to garrison it. In year fifteen Zheqi secretly allied with raw tribes to storm the city on a set day. A junior officer warned the garrison; troops seized and executed Zheqi. The raw tribes knew nothing and attacked on schedule; government troops ambushed and routed them, then moved all Qiang settlers outside the walls.
43
正德二年，太監羅籥奏，茂州所轄卜南村、曲山等寨，乞為白人，願納糧差。 其俗以白為善，以黑為惡。 禮部覆，番人向化，宜令入貢給賞。 從之。 十四年，巡撫馬昊調松潘兵，攻小東路番寨，而茂州核桃溝上、下關番蠻懼，遂糾白石、羅打鼓諸寨生番，攻圍城堡，遊擊張傑敗績。 十五年，巡撫盛應期奏，綽頭番犯松州，總兵張傑克之，復犯雄溪屯，指揮杜欽敗之，煙崇等寨皆降。 萬歷十九年，威、茂諸番作亂，攻破新橋，乘勢圍普安等堡。 四川巡撫李尚忠檄諸路兵追剿過河，普安諸堡得以保全。
In Zhengde 2 eunuch Luo Yu reported that Bonan village, Qushan, and other Maozhou stockades asked to register as "white" subjects and pay grain taxes. In their custom white signified virtue and black wickedness. The Ministry of Rites replied that tribes turning toward the court should present tribute and receive rewards. The court agreed. In year fourteen coordinator Ma Hao sent Songpan troops against eastern-route stockades; fearing attack, Walnut Gully tribes of Maozhou rallied Baishi, Luodagu, and other raw tribes to besiege forts, and mobile-corps commander Zhang Jie was defeated. In year fifteen coordinator Sheng Yingqi reported Chuatou tribes attacking Songzhou; commander Zhang Jie repelled them; they struck Xiongxi garrison and commander Du Qin defeated them; Yanchong and other stockades submitted. In Wanli 19 Wei and Mao tribes rebelled, took Xinqiao bridge, and besieged Pu'an and other forts. Sichuan coordinator Li Shangzhong ordered all columns to pursue them across the river, saving the Pu'an forts.
44
茂州地方數千里，自唐武德改郡會州，領羈縻州九，前後皆蠻族，向無城郭。 宋熙寧中，範百常知茂州，民請築城，而蠻人來爭。 百常與之拒，且戰且築，城乃得立。 自宋迄元，皆為羌人所據，不置州縣者幾二百年。 洪武十一年平蜀，置疊溪右千戶所，隸茂州衛。 而置威茂道，開府茂州，分遊擊以駐疊溪，規防始立。 然東路生羌，白草最強，又與松潘黃毛韃相通，出沒為寇，相沿不絕雲。 其通西域要路，為桃坪，即古桃關也，有繩橋渡江。 守桃坪者，為隴木司。
Maozhou sprawled over thousands of li; since Tang Wude, when the commandery became Huizhou with nine subordinate prefectures, it had been tribal land without walled cities. In Song Xining Fan Baichang governed Maozhou; locals sought walls, and tribesmen contested the work. Baichang fought them off, building as he battled, until the walls stood. From Song through Yuan Qiang tribes held it, and for nearly two centuries no regular prefecture or county was set. In Hongwu 11, after Shu was pacified, the Diexi Right battalion was placed under Maozhou Guard. The Weimao circuit was opened at Maozhou with detached mobile corps at Diexi, establishing frontier defense. Yet the eastern raw Qiang—Baicao the strongest—coordinated with Songpan's Yellow-Hair Tartars, raiding without cease. The key route west ran through Taoping, ancient Taoguan, crossed by rope bridge. Longmu office held Taoping.
45
茂州長官司三：曰隴木，曰靜州，曰疊溪。 隴木長官司，其長官即隴木裏人也。 洪武時歸附，授承直郎，世襲長官，歲貢馬二匹。 所屬玉亭、神溪十二寨，俱為編氓，有保長統之。 靜州長官司，其地即唐之悉唐縣，其長官亦靜州裏人也。 襲官貢馬，與隴木同。 正德間，與嶽希蓬、節孝為亂，攻茂城，斷水道七日。 節孝弟車勺潛引水以濟我軍。 事平，使車勺襲職，轄法虎、核桃溝八寨，俱編戶為氓，亦有保長統之。 疊溪千戶所，永樂四年置。 領長官司二：曰疊溪，在治北一里； 曰郁即，在治西十五里。 疊溪郁氏，洪武十五年歸附，給印世襲，凡三年貢馬四匹。 長官所轄河東熟番八寨，皆大姓，及馬路、小關七族。 其土舍轄河西小姓六寨。 地土廣遠。 饒畜產，稞麥路積。 人皆梟黠，名雖熟番，與生番等。 郁即長官啖保，萬歷十八年與黑水、松坪稱兵，攻新橋，明年伏誅。 漢關墩附近諸小姓，舊屬郁即，至是改屬疊溪。 初，都督方政平歷日諸寨，設長寧安撫司，隸松潘。 至正統元年，總兵蔣貴言其遼闊，亦改隸於疊溪守禦千戶。
Maozhou had three native magistracies: Longmu, Jingzhou, and Diexi. At Longmu magistracy the magistrate was a Longmu tribesman. He submitted in Hongwu, received Gentleman for Direct Service, hereditary magistracy, and two horses yearly. Twelve stockades—Yuting and Shenxi—were registered subjects under baojia heads. Jingzhou magistracy lay in Tang Xitang county; its magistrate was a Jingzhou tribesman. Hereditary succession and horse tribute matched Longmu. In Zhengde he rebelled with Yuexipeng and Jiexiao, assaulted Maozhou, and cut the waterworks for seven days. Jiexiao's brother Che Shao secretly restored water to the garrison. After the revolt Che Shao inherited the post over eight stockades including Fahu and Walnut Gully, all registered under baojia heads. Diexi battalion was established in Yongle 4. It oversaw two magistracies: Diexi, one li north of the seat; and Yuji, fifteen li west. The Yu clan of Diexi submitted in Hongwu 15, received a hereditary seal, and presented four horses every three years. East of the river eight tame-tribe stockades of great clans fell under him, with seven families of Malu and Xiaoguan. His native deputy held six lesser-clan stockades west of the river. The territory was vast. Livestock thrived and barley lined the roads. Its people were cunning; though called tame tribes, they matched the raw. Yuji magistrate Danbao in Wanli 18 rose with Heishui and Songping, attacked Xinqiao, and was executed the next year. Lesser clans near Hanguan fort, once under Yuji, were transferred to Diexi. Earlier commander Fang Zheng pacified Liri stockades and set up the Changning pacification commission under Songpan. In Zhengtong 1 commander Jiang Gui said it was too vast and reassigned it to the Diexi garrison battalion.
46
松潘，古氐羌地。 西漢置護羌校尉於此。 唐初置松州都督，廣德初，陷於吐蕃。 宋時，吐蕃將潘羅支領之，名潘州。 元置吐蕃宣慰司。
Songpan was ancient Di and Qiang land. Western Han posted a Protector of the Qiang here. Early Tang made it the Songzhou protectorate; in early Guangde Tibet seized it. In Song a Tibetan general named Panluozhi held it as Panzhou. The Yuan placed a Tibetan pacification commission there.
47
洪武十二年，命平羌將軍御史大夫丁玉定其地，敕之曰：「松潘僻在萬山，接西戎之境，朕豈欲窮兵遠討，但羌戎屢寇邊，征之不獲已也。 今捷至，知松州已克，徐將資糧於容州，進取潘州。 若盡三州之地，則疊州不須窮兵，自當來服。 須擇士勇者守納都、疊溪路，其驛道無阻遏者，不可守也。 來降諸戎長，必遣入朝，朕親撫諭之。 」遂並潘州於松州，置松州衛指揮使司。 丁玉遣寧州衛指揮高顯城其地。 十三年，帝以松州衛遠在山谷，屯種不給，饋餉為難，命罷之。 未幾，指揮耿忠經略其地，奏言松州為番蜀要害地，不可罷，命復置。
In Hongwu 12 the court sent Pacifying-Qiang general and censor-in-chief Ding Yu to settle the region, writing: "Songpan lies deep in the mountains on the western frontier. I do not seek distant conquest, yet Qiang and Rong raids leave no choice but war." Victory reports have arrived: Songzhou is taken; stage supplies at Rongzhou and press on to Panzhou. Once all three prefectures are secured, Diezhou will submit without a grinding campaign. Post brave officers on Nadou and the Diexi route; do not waste garrisons on unthreatened relay roads. Every surrendering tribal chief must be sent to court for the emperor's personal reassurance. The edict closed; Panzhou was merged into Songzhou and the Songzhou guard commandery was set up. Ding Yu dispatched Ningzhou guard commander Gao Xian to build the garrison. In year 13 the court abolished Songzhou Guard: the post lay deep in the mountains, farms could not feed it, and supply was too costly. Soon commander Geng Zhong urged that Songzhou was the strategic hinge between Tibetans and Shu and must stand; the guard was restored.
48
十四年置松潘等處安撫司，以龍州知州薛文勝為安撫使，秩從五品。 又置十三族長官司，秩正七品：曰勒都，曰阿昔洞，曰北定，曰牟力結，曰蛒匝，曰祈命，曰山洞，曰麥匝，曰者多，曰占藏先結，曰包藏先結，曰班班，曰白馬路。 其後復隸松潘者，長官司四，曰阿思，曰思囊兒，曰阿用，曰潘斡寨； 安撫司四，曰八郎，曰阿角寨，曰麻兒匝，曰芒兒者。 後又以思曩日安撫司附焉。 諸長官司每三年入貢，賞賜如例。 十五年，占藏先結等土酋來朝，貢馬一百三匹，詔賜綺鈔有差。 十六年，耿忠言：「臣所轄松潘等處安撫司屬各長官司，宜以其戶口之數，量其民力，歲令納馬置驛，而籍其民充驛夫，供徭役。 」從之。 既而松潘羌民作亂，官兵討平之。 甃松州及疊溪城。
In year 14 the Songpan pacification office was created with Longzhou prefect Xue Wensheng as commissioner at vice-fifth rank. Thirteen seventh-rank native magistracies followed: Ledou, Axidong, Beiding, Moulijie, Geza, Qiming, Shandong, Maiza, Zhiduo, Zhanzangxianjie, Baozangxianjie, Banban, and Baimalu. Later four native magistracies were again placed under Songpan: Asi, Sinang'er, Ayong, and Panwo stockade; and four pacification commissions: Balang, Ajiaozhai, Ma'erza, and Mang'erzhe. The Sisangri pacification office was later added as well. Each native magistracy sent triennial tribute and received the usual rewards. In year 15 chiefs including Zhanzangxianjie attended court with 130 horses and received graded gifts of brocade and silk. In year 16 Geng Zhong proposed: "Each native magistracy under Songpan pacification should, by household count and local capacity, supply horses yearly, maintain relay posts, and register men as couriers for corvée." The memorial was approved. Soon Songpan Qiang rose in revolt; government troops suppressed them. The walls of Songzhou and Diexi were rebuilt in brick.
49
十七年，松潘八積族老虎等寨蠻亂。 官兵擊破之，獲馬一百二十，犏牛三百，牦牛五百九十。 景川侯曹震請擇良馬貢京師，余給軍，其犏牛、牦牛非中國所畜，令易糧餉犒軍，從之。 十八年，松州羌反。 成都衛指揮成信等率兵攻其牟力等寨，破之。 兵還，又遇賊三千人於道，復擊敗之，追至乞剌河乃還。
In year 17 the Balang Eight-Stockade "Tiger" band and other Songpan stockades rebelled. Government troops routed them, taking 120 horses, 300 dzo, and 590 yaks. Marquis Cao Zhen asked that the best horses go to the capital and the rest to the troops; dzo and yaks, unfamiliar to the interior, were ordered exchanged for grain to reward the army, and the plan was approved. In year 18 the Songzhou Qiang revolted. Chengdu guard commander Cheng Xin and others stormed the Mouli stockades and broke them. On the march home they met 3,000 rebels, defeated them again, and pursued to the Qila River before withdrawing.
50
二十年改松州衛為松潘等處軍民指揮使司，改松潘安撫司為龍州。 二十一年，朵貢生番則路、南向等引草地生番千余人寇潘州阿昔洞長官司，殺傷人口。 指揮周助率馬步軍同松潘衛軍討之，番寇率眾迎戰，千戶劉德破之，斬首三十四級，獲馬三十余匹。 賊潰，渡河四十餘里，復收敗卒屯聚。 指揮周能追擊之，斬首一百三十余級，獲馬六十余匹，溺死甚眾，群番遠遁。 二十六年，西番思曩日等族來歸，進馬百三十匹，命給金銅信符並賜文綺襲衣。
In year 20 Songzhou guard became the Songpan military-civilian command, and the Songpan pacification office reverted to Longzhou. In year 21 Duogong tribesmen Zelu and Nanxiang led over a thousand grassland raiders against the Axidong magistracy in Panzhou, killing locals. Commander Zhou Zhu marched with Songpan guards; company commander Liu De routed the raiders, taking thirty-four heads and thirty-odd horses. The enemy fled forty-odd li across the river and rallied their broken bands. Commander Zhou Neng pursued, claiming 130-odd heads and sixty-odd horses; many drowned; the tribes scattered deep into the mountains. In year 26 western tribes including Sinangri submitted with 130 horses and received gold-bronze tallies, brocades, and court robes.
51
宣德二年，麻兒匝順化，喇嘛著八讓卜來歸。 置麻兒匝安撫司，以喇嘛著八讓卜為安撫。 麻兒匝在阿樂地，去松潘七百餘里。 初，著八讓卜時侵掠邊民及遮八郎安撫司朝貢路。 松潘衛指揮吳瑋遣人招之，因遣其侄完卜來貢獻，言其地廣民眾，過於八郎，請置宣撫司以轄之。 帝命置安撫，遣敕諭之。 四川巡按等奏松潘衛所轄阿用等寨蠻寇，擁眾萬余，傷敗官軍，請討之。 帝意邊將必有激之者。 既四川都司奏至，言並非番寇。 實由千戶錢宏因調發松潘官軍往征交址，眾憚行，宏詭言番寇至，當追捕，冀免調。 又領軍突入麥匝諸族，逼取牛馬，致番人忿怨。 復以大軍將致討懾之，番眾驚潰，約黑水生番為亂。 帝命逮宏等，而責諸司怠玩邊務，亟捕諸傷官軍者。 遣都指揮僉事蔣貴往，同松潘衛指揮吳瑋招撫番寇，令調附近諸衛軍二萬人以行。 時賊圍松潘、疊溪、茂州，斷索橋，官軍與戰皆敗，出掠綿竹諸縣，官署民居皆被焚毀，鎮撫侯璉死之。 蜀王遣護衛官校七千人來援，命都督陳懷與指揮蔣貴等合師亟討之，而梟宏於松潘以徇，並竄諸將之貪淫玩寇者。 三年，陳懷等率諸軍屢敗賊於圪答壩、葉棠關，奪永鎮等橋，復疊溪，撫定祁命等十族，又招降渴卓等二十余寨，松潘平。
In Xuande 2 Ma'erza submitted, and Lama Zhubarangbo came in allegiance. A Ma'erza pacification office was set up under Lama Zhubarangbo. Ma'erza lay in Ale country, over seven hundred li from Songpan. Earlier Zhubarangbo had raided border villages and blocked Balang's tribute road. Songpan commander Wu Wei summoned him; Zhubarangbo sent his nephew Wanbo to court, claiming a realm broader than Balang's and asking for a pacification office. The court created the pacification post and sent an instructing edict. Sichuan censors reported Ayong and other stockades under Songpan fielding 10,000-odd raiders who had beaten government troops and asked for a punitive expedition. The emperor suspected the border commanders had provoked the trouble. Then the Sichuan regional command reported that there were no Fan raiders at all. The trouble began when company commander Qian Hong, facing transfer to the Jiaozhi campaign, invented a Fan raid to avoid the draft. He then stormed Maiza and neighboring tribes, seizing cattle and horses and enraging the clans. Threatened by another major expedition, the tribes panicked and plotted rebellion with Heishui raw tribes. The emperor ordered Hong arrested, rebuked the border offices for negligence, and demanded the capture of anyone who had harmed troops. Regional commander Jiang Gui was dispatched with Songpan commander Wu Wei to negotiate while twenty thousand troops from neighboring guards were mobilized. Rebels besieged Songpan, Diexi, and Maozhou, cut rope bridges, and repeatedly defeated government forces; they raided Mianzhu and other counties, burning towns and killing pacification commissioner Hou Lian. The Prince of Shu sent 7,000 household guards; Chen Huai united with Jiang Gui to strike at once, executed Hong at Songpan as an example, and demoted corrupt, negligent officers. In year 3 Chen Huai won repeated victories at Geda Dam and Yetang Pass, retook Yongzhen bridge, restored Diexi, pacified ten tribes including Qiming, and won over twenty stockades such as Kezhuo; Songpan was quiet.
52
八年，八部安撫司及思囊兒十四族朝貢之使陛辭，令賫敕還諭其土官，俾約束所轄蠻民，安分循理，毋作過以取罪戾。 九年，敕指揮僉事方政、蔣貴等撫剿松潘。 政等至，榜諭禍福，威、茂諸衛俱聽命，惟松潘、疊溪所轄任昌、巴豬、黑虎等寨梗化。 政令指揮趙得、宮聚等以次進兵，平龍溪等三十七寨，班師還。 命蔣貴佩平蠻將軍印，鎮守松潘。 十年，貴奏，比因番人不靖，松潘、疊溪諸處倉糧，支銷殆盡，別無儲積。 帝命戶部於四川歲運之數，量益二分給之。
In year 8 envoys from eight pacification offices and Sinang'er's fourteen tribes were dismissed with edicts ordering their headmen to restrain their people and keep the peace. In year 9 the court ordered assistant commanders Fang Zheng and Jiang Gui to pacify Songpan. Fang Zheng posted warnings of reward and punishment; Wei and Mao guards submitted, but Renchang, Bazhu, Heihu, and other Songpan-Diexi stockades held out. Zheng sent Zhao De, Gong Ju, and others in succession to reduce thirty-seven stockades including Longxi, then withdrew. Jiang Gui was named Pacifying-Barbarians General and posted to garrison Songpan. In year 10 Gui reported that unrest had nearly emptied Songpan and Diexi granaries with no reserves left. The Ministry of Revenue was ordered to add two-tenths to Sichuan's annual grain shipment for the region.
53
正統三年，巖州長官司讓達作亂，侵雜道諸邊，雜道長官安白訴於朝。 帝命四川三司往諭之，皆歸服。 四年，松潘指揮趙得奏：「祁命族番寇商巴作亂，官軍捕擒之。 其弟小商巴復聚浦江、新塘等關，據險劫掠，乞發大軍剿除。 」帝命李安棄總兵官，王翺參贊軍務，調成都左衛官軍及松潘土兵，合二萬人征之。 已，翺知商巴為都指揮趙諒所陷，乃按誅諒而釋商巴等，事遂已。
In Zhengtong 3 Yanzhou magistrate Rangda rebelled and raided Zadao; magistrate An Bai appealed to court. The three Sichuan commissions were sent to admonish them, and all submitted. In year 4 Songpan commander Zhao De reported: "Qiming's Shangba rebelled and was captured by government troops. His brother Xiao Shangba then seized Pujiang and Xintang passes and raided, asking for a major expedition. The court named Li Anqi commander-in-chief and Wang Ao staff director, and sent 20,000 Chengdu and Songpan troops against them. Wang Ao soon found Shangba had been framed by regional commander Zhao Liang; Liang was executed and Shangba freed, ending the affair.
54
九年，松潘指揮僉事王杲奏：「比者，黑虎等寨番蠻攻圍椒園、松溪等關堡，殺傷官民。 欲行擒剿，恐各寨驚疑，應諭能擒賊者重賞之。 」報可。 十年，黑虎寨賊首多兒太伏誅。 初，多兒太掠茂州境，為官軍所獲，誠而釋之。 未幾，復糾諸寨入掠。 帝命序班祁全往諭諸寨，擒多兒太至京，梟其首。 十一年以寇深為僉都御史，提督松潘兵備。 時松潘皆已向化，惟歪地骨鹿族二十寨不服，命督高廣、王杲等剿之。 設思曩日安撫司，以阿思觀為之使，隸松潘衛。 先是，阿思觀父端葛，洪武中歸順，給金牌撫番，至阿思觀又能招撫，故有是命。
In year 9 assistant commander Wang Gao reported: "Heihu and other stockades have besieged Jiaoyuan and Songxi forts, killing officials and civilians." A full assault may alarm neighboring stockades; heavy rewards should go to whoever captures the ringleaders. The memorial was approved. In year 10 Heihu stockade chief Duo'ertai was beheaded. Duo'ertai had earlier raided Maozhou, been captured, and released on oath. Soon he rallied other stockades to raid again. The emperor sent protocol officer Qi Quan to summon the stockades; Duo'ertai was seized, sent to the capital, and executed. In year 11 Kou Shen was appointed vice censor-in-chief to oversee Songpan defenses. By then Songpan was largely pacified; only twenty Waidigulu stockades held out, and Gao Guang and Wang Gao were ordered to reduce them. A Sisangri pacification office was created under Asiguan, subordinate to Songpan guard. Asiguan's father Duange had submitted in Hongwu and received a gold tablet to pacify the tribes; Asiguan proved equally able, hence the appointment.
55
景泰三年，鎮守松潘刑部左侍郎羅綺等奏：「雪兒卜寨賊首卓時芳等，煙崇寨賊首阿兒結等，累年糾合於安化關劫掠。 臣會師抵其巢穴，斬首不計其數，生擒卓時芳、阿兒結等，梟斬於市。 」七年，提督松潘羅綺復奏：「松潘土番王永習性兒獷，嘗殺其土官高茂林男婦五百余口，及故土官董敏子伯浩等二十余人。 今又糾合番蠻，攻劫地方。 臣與指揮周貴等統領官軍，直抵桑坪，已將永等誅滅，邊境肅清。 」降敕褒賞。 天順五年，番眾入龍安、石泉等處，擾糧道。 六年敕松潘總兵許貴曰：「敘州蠻賊出沒為患，比松潘尤甚，其馳往會剿。 」貴聞命，會兵敘州，追討昔乖件、莫洞、都夜三寨，分兵兩哨，克硬寨四十余，斬首一千一百余級。
In Jingtai 3 Songpan garrison minister Luo Qi reported: "Xue'erbu chief Zhuo Shifang and Yanchong chief A'erjie have for years raided Anhua Pass." We stormed their lairs, took countless heads, and executed Zhuo Shifang and A'erjie in the market." In year 7 Luo Qi reported again: "The tribesman Wang Yong, savage by nature, had slaughtered 500-odd kin of magistrate Gao Maolin and twenty-odd kin of the late magistrate Dong Min's son Bo Hao." He has again rallied tribes to raid the district." I led troops with Zhou Gui to Sangping and destroyed Wang Yong's band; the frontier is quiet." The court issued a commendatory edict and rewards. In Tianshun 5 tribes entered Long'an and Shiquan, disrupting supply lines. In year 6 the emperor told Songpan commander Xu Gui: "Xuzhou rebels are worse than Songpan's; march at once to join the campaign there." Gui marched to Xuzhou, struck the Xiguaijian, Modong, and Duye stockades in two columns, took forty-odd strongholds, and claimed 1,100-odd heads.
56
成化二年，鎮守太監閻禮奏：「松、茂、疊溪所轄白草壩等寨，番羌聚眾五百人，越龍州境剽掠。 白草番者，唐吐蕃贊普遺種，上下凡十八寨。 部曲素強，恃其險阻，往往剽奪為患。 」四年，禮復奏：「白草諸番擁眾寇安縣、石泉諸處，因各軍俱調征山都掌蠻，致指揮王璟備禦不謹。 命副總兵盧能剿之。 能遣指揮閻斌巡邊至廟子溝，番賊三百突至，殺傷相當。 斌以失機逮治。 九年，巡撫夏塤奏：「黑虎寨賊首夜合等劫攻關堡，左參將宰用、兵備副使沈琮督兵馳詣松溪堡敗之，斬獲夜合等三十六級。 」松潘指揮僉事堯彧奏：「臣與兵備沈琮分剿白馬路水土、茹兒等番寨，大克之。
In Chenghua 2 garrison eunuch Yan Li reported: "Five hundred Baicao Dam tribesmen from Song, Mao, and Diexi crossed into Longzhou to raid." The Baicao people descend from Tang Tibetan royal stock; they number eighteen stockades altogether. Long fierce and sheltered by rugged terrain, they raid whenever opportunity allows." In year 4 Yan Li reported again: "Baicao tribes raided Anxian and Shiquan while troops were away fighting Shanduzhang; commander Wang Jing had grown lax." Vice commander Lu Neng was ordered to suppress them. Lu Neng sent Yan Bin to patrol Miaozigou; three hundred raiders struck and casualties were even on both sides. Yan Bin was arrested for missing his chance. In year 9 grand coordinator Xia Kan reported: "Heihu chief Yehe raided pass forts; Zai Yong and Shen Cong rushed to Songxi fort and took thirty-six heads including Yehe's."
